--// Aimbot Arena - Client Aim Assist + ESP
--// Place as a LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

--// Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

--// Rayfield
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Aimbot Arena",
    Icon = 0,
    LoadingTitle = "Aimbot Arena",
    LoadingSubtitle = "Aim Assist + ESP",
    Theme = "Default",

    ToggleUIKeybind = "K",

    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = true,
        FolderName = "AimbotArena",
        FileName = "Settings"
    },

    Discord = {
        Enabled = false
    },

    KeySystem = false
})

--// Settings
local Settings = {
    AimEnabled = false,
    AimOnRMB = true,

    TeamCheck = true,
    WallCheck = true,

    ESPEnabled = false,
    ESPNames = true,
    ESPDistance = true,

    FOVEnabled = true,
    FOV = 150,

    Smoothness = 0.15,

    TargetPart = "Head"
}

local HoldingRMB = false

--// ESP storage
local ESPObjects = {}

--// FOV circle
local FOVCircle = Drawing and Drawing.new("Circle")

if FOVCircle then
    FOVCircle.Visible = true
    FOVCircle.Filled = false
    FOVCircle.Thickness = 1
    FOVCircle.NumSides = 64
    FOVCircle.Radius = Settings.FOV
    FOVCircle.Transparency = 1
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
--// Utility
----------------------------------------------------------------

local function GetCharacter(player)
    if not player then
        return nil
    end

    local character = player.Character

    if not character then
        return nil
    end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return nil
    end

    return character
end

local function IsEnemy(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then
        return false
    end

    if not Settings.TeamCheck then
        return true
    end

    -- Standard Roblox team check
    if LocalPlayer.Team ~= nil and player.Team ~= nil then
        return LocalPlayer.Team ~= player.Team
    end

    return true
end

local function IsVisible(part)
    if not Settings.WallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local character = part.Parent

    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = part.Position - origin

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
        LocalPlayer.Character,
        Camera
    }
    params.IgnoreWater = true

    local result = workspace:Raycast(
        origin,
        direction,
        params
    )

    if not result then
        return true
    end

    return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end

local function GetTargetPart(character)
    return character:FindFirstChild(Settings.TargetPart)
        or character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function GetMousePosition()
    local mousePosition = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

    return Vector2.new(
        mousePosition.X,
        mousePosition.Y
    )
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
--// Target selection
----------------------------------------------------------------

local function GetClosestTarget()
    local mousePosition = GetMousePosition()

    local closestPlayer = nil
    local closestPart = nil
    local closestDistance = math.huge

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

        if IsEnemy(player) then

            local character = GetCharacter(player)

            if character then

                local targetPart = GetTargetPart(character)

                if targetPart then

                    local screenPosition, onScreen =
                        Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)

                    if onScreen and screenPosition.Z > 0 then

                        local screenPoint = Vector2.new(
                            screenPosition.X,
                            screenPosition.Y
                        )

                        local distance =
                            (screenPoint - mousePosition).Magnitude

                        if distance <= Settings.FOV then

                            if IsVisible(targetPart) then

                                if distance < closestDistance then
                                    closestDistance = distance
                                    closestPlayer = player
                                    closestPart = targetPart
                                end

                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closestPlayer, closestPart
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
--// Aim
----------------------------------------------------------------

local function AimAt(part)
    if not part then
        return
    end

    local cameraPosition = Camera.CFrame.Position

    local desiredCFrame =
        CFrame.lookAt(cameraPosition, part.Position)

    Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(
        desiredCFrame,
        math.clamp(Settings.Smoothness, 0.01, 1)
    )
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
--// ESP
----------------------------------------------------------------

local function RemoveESP(player)
    local esp = ESPObjects[player]

    if not esp then
        return
    end

    if esp.Highlight then
        esp.Highlight:Destroy()
    end

    if esp.Billboard then
        esp.Billboard:Destroy()
    end

    ESPObjects[player] = nil
end

local function CreateESP(player)

    if player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    if ESPObjects[player] then
        return
    end

    local esp = {}

    local character = GetCharacter(player)

    if not character then
        return
    end

    -- Highlight
    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "ArenaESP"
    highlight.Adornee = character
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.65
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0

    highlight.Parent = character

    esp.Highlight = highlight

    -- Billboard
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")

    if head then

        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

        billboard.Name = "ArenaESPInfo"
        billboard.Adornee = head
        billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 50)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true

        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")

        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.TextSize = 13
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5

        label.Text = player.Name

        label.Parent = billboard
        billboard.Parent = head

        esp.Billboard = billboard
        esp.Label = label
    end

    ESPObjects[player] = esp
end

local function UpdateESP(player)

    local esp = ESPObjects[player]

    if not esp then
        return
    end

    local character = GetCharacter(player)

    if not character then
        RemoveESP(player)
        return
    end

    if esp.Highlight then
        esp.Highlight.Enabled =
            Settings.ESPEnabled and IsEnemy(player)
    end

    if esp.Label then

        if not Settings.ESPEnabled or not IsEnemy(player) then
            esp.Label.Visible = false
            return
        end

        esp.Label.Visible = true

        local text = player.Name

        if Settings.ESPDistance then

            local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local localCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
            local localRoot =
                localCharacter and
                localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if root and localRoot then

                local distance =
                    math.floor(
                        (root.Position - localRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    )

                text = text .. " [" .. distance .. "m]"
            end
        end

        if Settings.ESPNames then
            esp.Label.Text = text
        else
            esp.Label.Text = ""
        end
    end
end

local function RefreshESP()

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

        if player ~= LocalPlayer then

            if Settings.ESPEnabled then
                CreateESP(player)
            else
                RemoveESP(player)
            end

        end
    end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
--// Player connections
----------------------------------------------------------------

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    RemoveESP(player)
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)

    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.5)

        if Settings.ESPEnabled then
            CreateESP(player)
        end
    end)

end)

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

    if player ~= LocalPlayer then

        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.5)

            if Settings.ESPEnabled then
                CreateESP(player)
            end
        end)

    end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
--// RMB
----------------------------------------------------------------

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)

    if processed then
        return
    end

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
        HoldingRMB = true
    end

end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
        HoldingRMB = false
    end

end)

----------------------------------------------------------------
--// Rayfield UI
----------------------------------------------------------------

local AimTab = Window:CreateTab(
    "Aim Assist",
    4483362458
)

AimTab:CreateSection("Aimbot")

AimTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Enable Aim Assist",
    CurrentValue = false,

    Callback = function(value)
        Settings.AimEnabled = value
    end
})

AimTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "RMB Activation",
    CurrentValue = true,

    Callback = function(value)
        Settings.AimOnRMB = value
    end
})

AimTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Team Check",
    CurrentValue = true,

    Callback = function(value)
        Settings.TeamCheck = value
    end
})

AimTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Wall Check",
    CurrentValue = true,

    Callback = function(value)
        Settings.WallCheck = value
    end
})

AimTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "FOV",
    Range = {25, 500},
    Increment = 5,
    Suffix = " px",
    CurrentValue = 150,

    Callback = function(value)
        Settings.FOV = value

        if FOVCircle then
            FOVCircle.Radius = value
        end
    end
})

AimTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Aim Smoothness",
    Range = {1, 100},
    Increment = 1,
    Suffix = "%",

    CurrentValue = 15,

    Callback = function(value)
        Settings.Smoothness = value / 100
    end
})

AimTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Show FOV",
    CurrentValue = true,

    Callback = function(value)
        Settings.FOVEnabled = value
    end
})

----------------------------------------------------------------
--// ESP Tab
----------------------------------------------------------------

local ESPTab = Window:CreateTab(
    "ESP",
    4483362458
)

ESPTab:CreateSection("Player ESP")

ESPTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Enable ESP",
    CurrentValue = false,

    Callback = function(value)

        Settings.ESPEnabled = value

        RefreshESP()
    end
})

ESPTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Names",
    CurrentValue = true,

    Callback = function(value)
        Settings.ESPNames = value
    end
})

ESPTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Distance",
    CurrentValue = true,

    Callback = function(value)
        Settings.ESPDistance = value
    end
})

----------------------------------------------------------------
--// Main loop
----------------------------------------------------------------

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- FOV
    ----------------------------------------------------------------

    if FOVCircle then

        local mousePosition = GetMousePosition()

        FOVCircle.Position = mousePosition
        FOVCircle.Radius = Settings.FOV
        FOVCircle.Visible = Settings.FOVEnabled
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Aim
    ----------------------------------------------------------------

    local shouldAim =
        Settings.AimEnabled
        and (
            not Settings.AimOnRMB
            or HoldingRMB
        )

    if shouldAim then

        local player, targetPart = GetClosestTarget()

        if player and targetPart then
            AimAt(targetPart)
        end
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ESP
    ----------------------------------------------------------------

    if Settings.ESPEnabled then

        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                CreateESP(player)
                UpdateESP(player)
            end

        end

    end

end)

Rayfield:LoadConfiguration()

Rayfield:Notify({
    Title = "Aimbot Arena",
    Content = "Aim assist loaded successfully.",
    Duration = 4
})

-- Fast Folder Search & Teleport Logic
local function findWorld14InSafeZone()
    local searchRoots = {Workspace, ReplicatedStorage}
    
    for _, rootContainer in ipairs(searchRoots) do
        local directFolder = rootContainer:FindFirstChild("SafeZone", true)
        if directFolder then
            local target = directFolder:FindFirstChild("World14", true)
            if target then
                return target
            end
        end
        
        for _, obj in ipairs(rootContainer:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj.Name == "SafeZone" then
                local target = obj:FindFirstChild("World14", true)
                if target then
                    return target
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

local function teleportToTarget(targetInstance)
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return false end
    
    local targetCFrame = nil
    if targetInstance:IsA("BasePart") then
        targetCFrame = targetInstance.CFrame
    elseif targetInstance:IsA("Model") then
        targetCFrame = targetInstance:GetPivot()
    else
        local firstPart = targetInstance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        if firstPart then targetCFrame = firstPart.CFrame end
    end
    
    if targetCFrame then
        myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        myRoot.CFrame = targetCFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        return true
    end
    return false
end

end)

-- Smart Strength Tool Finder
local function findBestStrengthTool()
    local currentUserName = string.lower(LocalPlayer.Name)
    local currentUserDisplayName = string.lower(LocalPlayer.DisplayName)
    
    local function matchesUser(name)
        local lower = string.lower(name)
        return lower == currentUserName or lower == currentUserDisplayName
    end

    local availableTools = {}

    local searchContainers = {Workspace, ReplicatedStorage, Players}
    for _, container in ipairs(searchContainers) do
        for _, obj in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
            if matchesUser(obj.Name) then
                for _, item in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                    if item:IsA("Tool") then
                        table.insert(availableTools, item)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") then
        for _, item in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Tool") then
                table.insert(availableTools, item)
            end
        end
    end

    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        for _, item in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Tool") then
                table.insert(availableTools, item)
            end
        end
    end

    if #availableTools == 0 then return nil end

    local bestTool = availableTools[1]
    for _, tool in ipairs(availableTools) do
        local tName = string.lower(tool.Name)
        if string.find(tName, "strength") or string.find(tName, "click") or string.find(tName, "weight") or string.find(tName, "dumbbell") or string.find(tName, "gym") then
            bestTool = tool
        end
    end

    return bestTool
end

-- Smart Punch/Combat Tool Finder
local function findPunchTool()
    local availableTools = {}

    if LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") then
        for _, item in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Tool") then
                table.insert(availableTools, item)
            end
        end
    end

    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        for _, item in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Tool") then
                table.insert(availableTools, item)
            end
        end
    end

    if #availableTools == 0 then return nil end

    local punchTool = availableTools[1]
    for _, tool in ipairs(availableTools) do
        local tName = string.lower(tool.Name)
        if string.find(tName, "punch") or string.find(tName, "sword") or string.find(tName, "combat") or string.find(tName, "gloves") or string.find(tName, "fist") or string.find(tName, "weapon") then
            punchTool = tool
            break
        end
    end

    return punchTool
end

-- Feature Loops (Persistent & Respawn-Safe)
local function startAutoTrainLoop()
    task.spawn(function()
        while isAutoTraining do
            local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            local humanoid = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            
            if myChar and humanoid then
                local bestTool = findBestStrengthTool()
                local equippedTool = myChar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
                
                if bestTool and equippedTool ~= bestTool then
                    if equippedTool then equippedTool.Parent = backpack end
                    if bestTool.Parent == backpack then
                        humanoid:EquipTool(bestTool)
                    elseif bestTool:IsA("Tool") then
                        bestTool.Parent = myChar
                    end
                    equippedTool = bestTool
                end
                
                if equippedTool and equippedTool.Parent == myChar then
                    pcall(function() equippedTool:Activate() end)
                end
                
                pcall(function()
                    for _, remote in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
                        if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                            local rName = string.lower(remote.Name)
                            if string.find(rName, "train") or string.find(rName, "click") or string.find(rName, "strength") then
                                remote:FireServer()
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            task.wait(0.12)
        end
    end)
end

local function startAutoRebirthLoop()
    task.spawn(function()
        while isAutoRebirth do
            local currentUserName = string.lower(LocalPlayer.Name)
            local currentUserDisplayName = string.lower(LocalPlayer.DisplayName)
            
            local function matchesUser(name)
                local lower = string.lower(name)
                return lower == currentUserName or lower == currentUserDisplayName
            end

            local searchContainers = {Workspace, ReplicatedStorage, Players, LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")}
            for _, container in ipairs(searchContainers) do
                if container then
                    for _, obj in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
                        if matchesUser(obj.Name) or obj.Name == "MainGui" or obj.Name == "PlayerGui" then
                            local rebirthObj = obj:FindFirstChild("Rebirth", true)
                            if rebirthObj then
                                if rebirthObj:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                                    pcall(function() rebirthObj:FireServer() end)
                                elseif rebirthObj:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                                    pcall(function() rebirthObj:InvokeServer() end)
                                elseif rebirthObj:IsA("TextButton") or rebirthObj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(rebirthObj.MouseButton1Click)) do
                                            conn:Fire()
                                        end
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            pcall(function()
                for _, remote in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
                    if (remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") or remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")) and string.find(string.lower(remote.Name), "rebirth") then
                        if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then remote:FireServer() else remote:InvokeServer() end
                    end
                end
            end)

            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)
end

local function startFastPunchLoop()
    task.spawn(function()
        while isFastPunching do
            local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            local humanoid = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            
            if myChar and humanoid then
                local punchTool = findPunchTool()
                local equippedTool = myChar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
                
                if punchTool and equippedTool ~= punchTool then
                    if equippedTool then equippedTool.Parent = backpack end
                    if punchTool.Parent == backpack then
                        humanoid:EquipTool(punchTool)
                    elseif punchTool:IsA("Tool") then
                        punchTool.Parent = myChar
                    end
                    equippedTool = punchTool
                end
                
                if equippedTool and equippedTool.Parent == myChar then
                    pcall(function()
                        equippedTool:Activate()

                end
                
                pcall(function()
                    for _, remote in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
                        if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                            local rName = string.lower(remote.Name)
                            if string.find(rName, "punch") or string.find(rName, "attack") or string.find(rName, "hit") or string.find(rName, "damage") or string.find(rName, "combat") then
                                remote:FireServer()
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            task.wait(0.05) -- Super fast punching speed with zero lag
        end
    end)
end

scripts.code:
local Services = setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(Self, Service)
            return cloneref(game:GetService(Service))
        end
    })

    local Players = Services.Players
    local UserInputService = Services.UserInputService
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    local App = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ChessClient.App)
    local mastermindbotplayer = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Chess.VortexBot)
    local BoardHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Chess.Engine)

    -- variables
    local Lasttimeplayed = -1
    local dragging       = false
    local dragStart      = nil
    local panelStartPos  = nil

    -- gui
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "MoveAssist"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
    panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 70)
    panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 68)
    panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 17)
    panel.BorderSizePixel = 1
    panel.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 60)
    panel.Active = true
    panel.Parent = gui

    local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
    titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 32)
    titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    titleBar.Parent = panel

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -25, 1, 0)
    title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    title.TextSize = 13
    title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.Text = "move assist"
    title.Parent = titleBar

    local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
    close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 22)
    close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0)
    close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    close.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    close.TextSize = 14
    close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    close.Text = "X"
    close.Parent = titleBar

    local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -28)
    status.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 28)
    status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    status.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    status.TextSize = 15
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    status.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    status.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    status.Text = "Join a Game"
    status.Parent = panel

    titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging       = true
            dragStart      = input.Position
            panelStartPos  = panel.Position
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local d = input.Position - dragStart
            panel.Position = UDim2.new(panelStartPos.X.Scale, panelStartPos.X.Offset + d.X, panelStartPos.Y.Scale, panelStartPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)

    close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        pcall(function() App.board:setArrow("best", nil) end)
        gui:Destroy()
    end)


    -- logic / the main stuff

    local function clearArrow()
        pcall(function() App.board:setArrow("best", nil) end)
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(0.25) do
            if not gui.Parent then 
                break 
            end
            
            local sexsision = App.session

            if not sexsision or sexsision.kind ~= "online" or sexsision.over then
                status.Text = "Join a Game"
                clearArrow()
                Lasttimeplayed = -1

            elseif not sexsision:isMyTurn() then
                if #sexsision.ucis ~= Lasttimeplayed then
                    clearArrow()
                    Lasttimeplayed = -1
                end
                status.Text = "Wait for your turn"

            elseif #sexsision.ucis ~= Lasttimeplayed then
                local theSigmaMove = mastermindbotplayer.think(sexsision.startFen, table.clone(sexsision.ucis), { rating = 1200 }, {})
                local whereItWas, whereItGoes = theSigmaMove:sub(1, 2), theSigmaMove:sub(3, 4)

                App.board:setArrow("best", BoardHelper.algToIndex64(whereItWas), BoardHelper.algToIndex64(whereItGoes), Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 130), 0.2)
                
                Lasttimeplayed = #sexsision.ucis
                status.Text = whereItWas .. " > " .. whereItGoes
            end
        end
    end)

scripts.author: ScriCten
scripts.summary: This is just a basic, keyless, universal, Ai generated script that lets you fly. Best speed: 32 on boost.
scripts.code:
--==================================================
-- PROJECT MAN OF STEEL
-- R15 SUPERMAN FLIGHT + LANDING ASSIST
-- CLIENT-SIDE VERSION
--==================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- SETTINGS
local BASE_SPEED = 100
local MAX_SPEED = 500
local BOOST_MULTIPLIER = 2
local BOOM_SPEED = 250
local ANIMATION_SMOOTHNESS = 14
local BANK_ANGLE = 45

-- LANDING ASSIST
local LANDING_DISTANCE = 25
local SAFE_FALL_SPEED = -18
local LANDING_ASSIST_DURATION = 15

local Speed = BASE_SPEED
local Flying = false
local Boosting = false
local BoomEnabled = true

local Character
local Humanoid
local Root
local Motors = {}
local CurrentPose = {}

local Attachment
local Velocity
local Orientation

local LastBoom = 0
local LandingAssistUntil = 0

--==================================================
-- CHARACTER SETUP
--==================================================

local function SetupCharacter(char)
    Character = char
    Humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    Root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    Motors = {}
    CurrentPose = {}

    for _, object in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("Motor6D") then
            Motors[object.Name] = object
            CurrentPose[object.Name] = CFrame.identity
        end
    end
end

if Player.Character then
    SetupCharacter(Player.Character)
else
    SetupCharacter(Player.CharacterAdded:Wait())
end

--==================================================
-- GUI
--==================================================

local oldGUI = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ManOfSteelR15")
if oldGUI then
    oldGUI:Destroy()
end

local GUI = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
GUI.Name = "ManOfSteelR15"
GUI.ResetOnSpawn = false
GUI.IgnoreGuiInset = true
GUI.Parent = PlayerGui

local function Round(object, radius)
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 10)
    corner.Parent = object
end

local function MakeButton(parent, text, size, position)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = size
    button.Position = position
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 65, 120)
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    button.Text = text
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    button.TextSize = 14
    button.Parent = parent

    Round(button, 9)

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
    stroke.Thickness = 1.5
    stroke.Parent = button

    return button
end

local Main = Instance.new("Frame")
Main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 270)
Main.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0.25, 0)
Main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 15, 30)
Main.BorderSizePixel = 0
Main.Parent = GUI
Round(Main, 12)

local outline = Instance.new("UIStroke")
outline.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255)
outline.Thickness = 2
outline.Parent = Main

local Header = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
Header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Header.Text = "⚡ MAN OF STEEL R15"
Header.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 190, 255)
Header.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Header.TextSize = 16
Header.Parent = Main

local Status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 25)
Status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40)
Status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Status.Text = "STATUS: GROUNDED"
Status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
Status.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Status.TextSize = 12
Status.Parent = Main

local SpeedBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
SpeedBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 32)
SpeedBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 70)
SpeedBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 35, 55)
SpeedBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
SpeedBox.Text = tostring(BASE_SPEED)
SpeedBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
SpeedBox.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
SpeedBox.TextSize = 14
SpeedBox.Parent = Main
Round(SpeedBox, 8)

SpeedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local value = tonumber(SpeedBox.Text)
    if value then
        Speed = math.clamp(value, 10, MAX_SPEED)
    end
    SpeedBox.Text = tostring(Speed)
end)

local FlightButton = MakeButton(
    Main, "ENABLE FLIGHT",
    UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36),
    UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 112)
)

local BoostButton = MakeButton(
    Main, "BOOST: OFF",
    UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36),
    UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 154)
)

local BoomButton = MakeButton(
    Main, "SONIC BOOM: ON",
    UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36),
    UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 196)
)

local CloseButton = MakeButton(
    Main, "CLOSE MENU",
    UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28),
    UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 237)
)

--==================================================
-- DRAGGABLE GUI
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

Header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = Main.Position
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    ) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        Main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- REOPEN BUTTON
--==================================================

local Reopen = MakeButton(
    GUI, "OPEN FLIGHT",
    UDim2.fromOffset(125, 42),
    UDim2.new(0, 15, 0.45, 0)
)

Reopen.Visible = false

CloseButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    Main.Visible = false
    Reopen.Visible = true
end)

Reopen.Activated:Connect(function()
    Main.Visible = true
    Reopen.Visible = false
end)

--==================================================
-- R15 ANIMATION
--==================================================

local function AnimateMotor(name, target, alpha)
    local motor = Motors[name]
    if not motor then return end

    local current = CurrentPose[name] or CFrame.identity
    local updated = current:Lerp(target, alpha)

    CurrentPose[name] = updated
    motor.Transform = updated
end

local function SupermanPose(sideways, alpha)
    AnimateMotor("Waist",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(18), 0, math.rad(-sideways * 25)), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("Neck",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, math.rad(sideways * 8)), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("LeftShoulder",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(85), 0, math.rad(-8)), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("RightShoulder",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(85), 0, math.rad(8)), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("LeftElbow",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-8), 0, 0), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("RightElbow",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-8), 0, 0), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("LeftWrist",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(5), 0, 0), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("RightWrist",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(5), 0, 0), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("LeftHip",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-75), 0, math.rad(-5)), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("RightHip",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-75), 0, math.rad(5)), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("LeftKnee",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(15), 0, 0), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("RightKnee",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(15), 0, 0), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("LeftAnkle",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-5), 0, 0), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("RightAnkle",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-5), 0, 0), alpha)
end

local function HoverPose(alpha)
    AnimateMotor("Waist", CFrame.identity, alpha)
    AnimateMotor("Neck", CFrame.identity, alpha)

    AnimateMotor("LeftShoulder",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, math.rad(-8)), alpha)

    AnimateMotor("RightShoulder",
        CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, math.rad(8)), alpha)

    local names = {
        "LeftElbow", "RightElbow",
        "LeftWrist", "RightWrist",
        "LeftHip", "RightHip",
        "LeftKnee", "RightKnee",
        "LeftAnkle", "RightAnkle"
    }

    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        AnimateMotor(name, CFrame.identity, alpha)
    end
end

local function ResetPose()
    for name, motor in pairs(Motors) do
        motor.Transform = CFrame.identity
        CurrentPose[name] = CFrame.identity
    end
end

--==================================================
-- SONIC BOOM
--==================================================

local function SonicBoom()
    if not Root then return end

    local ring = Instance.new("Part")
    ring.Name = "SonicBoomVisual"
    ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 5, 5)
    ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    ring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 255)
    ring.Transparency = 0.15
    ring.Anchored = true
    ring.CanCollide = false
    ring.CFrame = Root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
    ring.Parent = workspace

    local tween = TweenService:Create(
        ring,
        TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart),
        {
            Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 35, 35),
            Transparency = 1
        }
    )

    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Connect(function()
        ring:Destroy()
    end)
end

--==================================================
-- LANDING ASSIST
--==================================================

local function SafeLandingAssist()
    if not Root or not Character then return end
    if os.clock() > LandingAssistUntil then return end

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Character}

    local result = workspace:Raycast(
        Root.Position,
        Vector3.new(0, -LANDING_DISTANCE, 0),
        params
    )

    if not result then return end

    local velocity = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity

    if velocity.Y < SAFE_FALL_SPEED then
        Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
            velocity.X,
            SAFE_FALL_SPEED,
            velocity.Z
        )
    end

    if Humanoid
    and Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
        LandingAssistUntil = 0
    end
end

--==================================================
-- FLIGHT
--==================================================

local function StartFlying()
    if Flying or not Root or not Humanoid then return end

    Flying = true
    LandingAssistUntil = 0

    Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
    Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)

    Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    Attachment.Parent = Root

    Velocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
    Velocity.Attachment0 = Attachment
    Velocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    Velocity.MaxForce = math.huge
    Velocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
    Velocity.Parent = Root

    Orientation = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
    Orientation.Attachment0 = Attachment
    Orientation.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
    Orientation.Responsiveness = 25
    Orientation.MaxTorque = math.huge
    Orientation.Parent = Root

    Status.Text = "STATUS: FLYING"
    Status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)
    FlightButton.Text = "DISABLE FLIGHT"
end

local function StopFlying()
    if not Flying then return end

    Flying = false
    Boosting = false
    LandingAssistUntil = os.clock() + LANDING_ASSIST_DURATION

    if Velocity then Velocity:Destroy() end
    if Orientation then Orientation:Destroy() end
    if Attachment then Attachment:Destroy() end

    Velocity = nil
    Orientation = nil
    Attachment = nil

    if Humanoid then
        Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
        Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end

    ResetPose()

    Status.Text = "STATUS: LANDING ASSIST"
    Status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)

    FlightButton.Text = "ENABLE FLIGHT"
    BoostButton.Text = "BOOST: OFF"
end

FlightButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if Flying then
        StopFlying()
    else
        StartFlying()
    end
end)

BoostButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    Boosting = not Boosting
    BoostButton.Text = Boosting and "BOOST: ON" or "BOOST: OFF"
end)

BoomButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    BoomEnabled = not BoomEnabled
    BoomButton.Text = BoomEnabled
        and "SONIC BOOM: ON"
        or "SONIC BOOM: OFF"
end)

--==================================================
-- FLIGHT ENGINE
--==================================================

RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
    if not Root or not Humanoid then return end

    if not Flying then
        SafeLandingAssist()

        if os.clock() > LandingAssistUntil
        and Status.Text == "STATUS: LANDING ASSIST" then
            Status.Text = "STATUS: GROUNDED"
            Status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
        end

        return
    end

    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return end

    local cameraLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
    local cameraRight = camera.CFrame.RightVector
    local move = Humanoid.MoveDirection

    local flatForward = Vector3.new(cameraLook.X, 0, cameraLook.Z)
    local flatRight = Vector3.new(cameraRight.X, 0, cameraRight.Z)

    if flatForward.Magnitude > 0.01 then
        flatForward = flatForward.Unit
    else
        flatForward = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    end

    if flatRight.Magnitude > 0.01 then
        flatRight = flatRight.Unit
    else
        flatRight = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
    end

    local forwardInput = move:Dot(flatForward)
    local sideInput = move:Dot(flatRight)

    local direction =
        cameraLook * forwardInput
        + cameraRight * sideInput

    local moving = direction.Magnitude > 0.05

    local actualSpeed = Speed
    if Boosting then
        actualSpeed = math.min(
            Speed * BOOST_MULTIPLIER,
            MAX_SPEED
        )
    end

    local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-ANIMATION_SMOOTHNESS * dt)

    if moving then
        direction = direction.Unit
        Velocity.VectorVelocity = direction * actualSpeed

        local sideways = math.clamp(sideInput, -1, 1)

        local facing = CFrame.lookAt(
            Root.Position,
            Root.Position + direction,
            Vector3.yAxis
        )

        local horizontalPose =
            facing * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)

        local bank = math.rad(-sideways * BANK_ANGLE)

        Orientation.CFrame =
            CFrame.fromAxisAngle(direction, bank) * horizontalPose

        SupermanPose(sideways, alpha)
    else
        Velocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero

        local flatLook = Vector3.new(
            cameraLook.X,
            0,
            cameraLook.Z
        )

        if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then
            Orientation.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
                Root.Position,
                Root.Position + flatLook.Unit
            )
        end

        HoverPose(alpha)
    end

    if BoomEnabled
    and moving
    and actualSpeed >= BOOM_SPEED
    and os.clock() - LastBoom >= 1.5 then
        LastBoom = os.clock()
        SonicBoom()
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- RESPAWN
--==================================================

Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    if Flying then
        StopFlying()
    end

    LandingAssistUntil = 0
    task.wait(1)
    SetupCharacter(char)

    Status.Text = "STATUS: GROUNDED"
    FlightButton.Text = "ENABLE FLIGHT"
end)

end

local SliderUpdaters = {}

local function CreateSlider(titleText, suffix, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, callback)
	local Row = Instance.new("Frame")
	Row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56)
	Row.BackgroundColor3 = Palette.Surface
	Row.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Row.Parent = Container
	local RowStroke = Stroke(Row, Palette.Stroke, 1)

	local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 18)
	Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0, 7)
	Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Label.Text = titleText
	Label.TextColor3 = Palette.TextPrimary
	Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	Label.TextSize = 12
	Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	Label.Parent = Row

	local ValueText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	ValueText.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 18)
	ValueText.Position = UDim2.new(1, -71, 0, 7)
	ValueText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ValueText.Text = tostring(defaultVal) .. suffix
	ValueText.TextColor3 = Palette.TextSecondary
	ValueText.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	ValueText.TextSize = 11
	ValueText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	ValueText.Parent = Row

	local Hitbox = Instance.new("TextButton")
	Hitbox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 20)
	Hitbox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0, 30)
	Hitbox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Hitbox.Text = ""
	Hitbox.Parent = Row

	local Bar = Instance.new("Frame")
	Bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3)
	Bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -1)
	Bar.BackgroundColor3 = Palette.Track
	Bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Bar.Parent = Hitbox
	Corner(Bar, 99)

	local initRatio = (defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
	local TargetRatio = initRatio
	local CurrentRatio = initRatio

	local Fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	Fill.Size = UDim2.new(initRatio, 0, 1, 0)
	Fill.BackgroundColor3 = Palette.Accent
	Fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Fill.Parent = Bar
	Corner(Fill, 99)

	local Thumb = Instance.new("Frame")
	Thumb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
	Thumb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	Thumb.Position = UDim2.new(initRatio, 0, 0.5, 0)
	Thumb.BackgroundColor3 = Palette.TextPrimary
	Thumb.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Thumb.ZIndex = 2
	Thumb.Parent = Bar
	Corner(Thumb, 99)
	Stroke(Thumb, Palette.Base, 1.5)

	local Sliding = false
	local function Update(input)
		local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - Bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / Bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		TargetRatio = pos
		local val = math.floor(minVal + ((maxVal - minVal) * pos) + 0.5)
		ValueText.Text = tostring(val) .. suffix
		callback(val)
	end

	Hitbox.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			Sliding = true
			Anim(RowStroke, { Color = Palette.StrokeFocus }, 0.08)
			Anim(ValueText, { TextColor3 = Palette.TextPrimary }, 0.08)
			Anim(Thumb, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 15) }, 0.08)
			Update(input)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and Sliding then
			Sliding = false
			Anim(RowStroke, { Color = Palette.Stroke }, 0.12)
			Anim(ValueText, { TextColor3 = Palette.TextSecondary }, 0.12)
			Anim(Thumb, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12) }, 0.12)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if Sliding and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			Update(input)
		end
	end)

	Row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		Anim(Row, { BackgroundColor3 = Palette.SurfaceHover }, 0.08)
	end)

	Row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		Anim(Row, { BackgroundColor3 = Palette.Surface }, 0.08)
	end)

	table.insert(SliderUpdaters, function(alpha)
		CurrentRatio = CurrentRatio + (TargetRatio - CurrentRatio) * alpha
		Fill.Size = UDim2.new(CurrentRatio, 0, 1, 0)
		Thumb.Position = UDim2.new(CurrentRatio, 0, 0.5, 0)
	end)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-36 * dt)
	MainFrame.Position = MainFrame.Position:Lerp(TargetPos, alpha)
	for _, fn in ipairs(SliderUpdaters) do
		fn(alpha)
	end
end)

CreateToggle("Speed & Handling", "Boost acceleration and cornering grip", Config.Enabled, function(state)
	Config.Enabled = state
end)

CreateSlider("Speed Boost", "", 0, 200, Config.SpeedBoost, function(val)
	Config.SpeedBoost = val
end)

CreateSlider("Max Speed", " km/h", 100, 600, Config.MaxSpeedLimit, function(val)
	Config.MaxSpeedLimit = val
end)

CreateSlider("Turn Speed", "%", 0, 100, Config.TurnAssist, function(val)
	Config.TurnAssist = val
end)

local function GetVehicleSeat()
	local Char = LocalPlayer.Character
	local Hum = Char and Char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if Hum and Hum.SeatPart and Hum.SeatPart:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
		return Hum.SeatPart
	end
	local CarsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CrashTest") and Workspace.CrashTest:FindFirstChild("Cars")
	if CarsFolder then
		for _, car in ipairs(CarsFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if string.find(car.Name, LocalPlayer.Name) and car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat") then
				return car.DriverSeat
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if not Config.Enabled then return end

	local Seat = GetVehicleSeat()
	if not Seat then return end

	local Throttle = Seat.ThrottleFloat
	local Steer = Seat.SteerFloat
	local CurrentVel = Seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local Speed = CurrentVel.Magnitude

	if Config.SpeedBoost > 0 and math.abs(Throttle) > 0.05 then
		if Speed < Config.MaxSpeedLimit then
			local Forward = Seat.CFrame.LookVector * Throttle
			local Boost = Forward * (Config.SpeedBoost * dt * 2.2)
			local Down = Vector3.new(0, -Config.Downforce * dt * 0.5, 0)
			Seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity = CurrentVel + Boost + Down
		end
	end

	if Config.TurnAssist > 0 and math.abs(Steer) > 0.05 and Speed > 10 then
		local SpeedScale = math.clamp(Speed / 80, 0.7, 2.5)
		local TargetYaw = -Steer * (Config.TurnAssist * 0.04) * SpeedScale
		local AngVel = Seat.AssemblyAngularVelocity
		Seat.AssemblyAngularVelocity = AngVel:Lerp(Vector3.new(AngVel.X, TargetYaw, AngVel.Z), 0.35)

		local Dir = Seat.CFrame.LookVector * (Throttle >= 0 and 1 or -1)
		local FlatVel = Vector3.new(CurrentVel.X, 0, CurrentVel.Z)
		local AlignedVel = FlatVel:Lerp(Dir * FlatVel.Magnitude, 0.12)
		Seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(AlignedVel.X, CurrentVel.Y, AlignedVel.Z)
	end
end)

-- IF YOU WANT TO MODIFY SOMETHING OF THE SCRIPT AND REUPLOAD IT IDC, YOU CAN ;)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local speed = 5

-- STATUS

status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
status.Text = "Status: OFF"

status.ZIndex = 11

-- SPEED LABEL
local speedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
speedLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 85)
speedLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 25)
speedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
speedLabel.Text = "Speed:"
speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
speedLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
speedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
speedLabel.TextSize = 14
speedLabel.ZIndex = 11
speedLabel.Parent = frame

-- SPEED TEXTBOX
local textbox = Instance.new("TextBox")
textbox.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(195, 82)
textbox.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(95, 30)
textbox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 65)

-- SLIDER
local slider = Instance.new("Frame")

slider.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 10)

local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
fill.ZIndex = 12

local knob = Instance.new("TextButton")

local knobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

knobCorner.Parent = knob

-- SPEED DISPLAY
local function renderSpeed()
    local percent = (speed - MIN_SPEED) / (MAX_SPEED - MIN_SPEED)

    textbox.Text = tostring(speed)
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 1, 0)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 0.5, 0)
end

-- WARNING WINDOWS
local showWarning

showWarning = function(step)
    confirmationOpen = true

    local messages = {
        "Are you sure to loop TP at 10+ speed?\n\nRapid movement may cause eye strain or dizziness.",
        "Are you really really sure?",
        "Last warning! Rapid teleporting may damage your vision.\n\nAre you absolutely sure?"
    }

    local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
    overlay.Name = "WarningOverlay"
    overlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
    overlay.Active = true
    overlay.ZIndex = 50
    overlay.Parent = gui

    local window = Instance.new("Frame")
    window.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(350, 190)
    window.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -175, 0.5, -95)
    window.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
    window.BorderSizePixel = 0
    window.ZIndex = 51
    window.Parent = overlay

    local windowCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    windowCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    windowCorner.Parent = window

    local heading = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    heading.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    heading.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 55, 35)
    heading.Text = "WARNING " .. step .. "/3"
    heading.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    heading.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    heading.TextSize = 18
    heading.ZIndex = 52
    heading.Parent = window

    local message = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 50)
    message.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 75)
    message.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    message.Text = messages[step]
    message.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    message.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    message.TextSize = 14
    message.TextWrapped = true
    message.ZIndex = 52
    message.Parent = window

    local function makeButton(name, position, color)
        local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
        button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(145, 38)
        button.Position = position
        button.BackgroundColor3 = color
        button.Text = name
        button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        button.TextSize = 14
        button.ZIndex = 53
        button.Parent = window

        local buttonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        buttonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
        buttonCorner.Parent = button

        return button
    end

    local confirm = makeButton(
        "CONFIRM",
        UDim2.fromOffset(15, 140),
        Color3.fromRGB(35, 155, 75)
    )

    local cancel = makeButton(
        "CANCEL",
        UDim2.fromOffset(190, 140),
        Color3.fromRGB(180, 45, 45)
    )

    confirm.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        overlay:Destroy()

        if step < 3 then
            showWarning(step + 1)
        else
            confirmationOpen = false
            highSpeedApproved = true

            if pendingSpeed then
                speed = pendingSpeed
                pendingSpeed = nil
                renderSpeed()
            end
        end
    end)

    cancel.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        overlay:Destroy()
        confirmationOpen = false
        pendingSpeed = nil
        renderSpeed()
    end)
end

-- SET SPEED
local function setSpeed(value)
    if confirmationOpen then
        return
    end

    value = math.clamp(
        math.floor(value + 0.5),
        MIN_SPEED,
        MAX_SPEED
    )

    if value >= 10 and not highSpeedApproved then
        pendingSpeed = value
        showWarning(1)
        return
    end

    speed = value
    renderSpeed()
end

local sliding = false

local function updateSlider(input)
    if confirmationOpen then
        return
    end

    local percent = math.clamp(
        (input.Position.X - slider.AbsolutePosition.X)
        / slider.AbsoluteSize.X,
        0,
        1
    )

    setSpeed(MIN_SPEED + percent * (MAX_SPEED - MIN_SPEED))
end

local function startSliding(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        updateSlider(input)
    end
end

        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        updateSlider(input)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        sliding = false
    end
end)

    else

    end
end)

local function setEnabled(value)

        toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 160, 75)
    else
        status.Text = "Status: OFF"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
        toggleButton.Text = "START TELEPORT"
        toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 45, 45)
    end
end

toggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setEnabled(not enabled)
end)

-- TELEPORT LOOP
local elapsed = 0
local forward = true

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    if not enabled then
        elapsed = 0
        return
    end

    elapsed += deltaTime

    if elapsed >= 1 / speed then
        elapsed = 0

        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if root then
            local offset = root.CFrame.LookVector * distance

            if forward then
                root.CFrame = root.CFrame + offset
            else
                root.CFrame = root.CFrame - offset
            end

            forward = not forward
        end
    end
end)

-- F KEY TOGGLE
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if not processed and not confirmationOpen
        and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then

        setEnabled(not enabled)
    end
end)

-- DRAGGABLE MENU
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition
local dragInput

title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = frame.Position
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

local function level()
    local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
    local value = data and data:FindFirstChild("Level")
    return value and value.Value or 1
end

local function currentQuest()
    local currentLevel = level()
    for _, quest in ipairs(quests[sea]) do
        if currentLevel >= quest.min and currentLevel <= quest.max then
            return quest
        end
    end
end

local function questShown()
    local gui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local main = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Main")
    local frame = main and main:FindFirstChild("Quest")
    return frame and frame.Visible
end

local lastQuest
local function startQuest(quest)
    local key = quest.id .. ":" .. quest.index
    if lastQuest == key and questShown() then return end
    local ok = pcall(function()
        comm:InvokeServer("StartQuest", quest.id, quest.index)
    end)
    if ok then lastQuest = key end
end

local function findMob(name)
    local root = characterRoot()
    if not root then return end
    local closest, target, prefix = math.huge, nil, name .. " ["
    for _, mob in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
        if mob.Name == name or mob.Name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
            local humanoid = mob:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local part = mob:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if humanoid and part and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local distance = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                if distance < closest then
                    closest, target = distance, mob
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

local function moveTo(quest, mob)
    local root = characterRoot()
    if not root then return end

    while running and root.Parent and characterRoot() == root and currentQuest() == quest do
        local targetRoot = mob and mob:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local targetHumanoid = mob and mob:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if mob and (not targetRoot or not targetHumanoid or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0) then break end

        local goal = (targetRoot and targetRoot.Position or quest.position.Position) + offset
        local direction = goal - root.Position
        local distance = direction.Magnitude
        if distance <= 5 then
            if mob then attack(mob) end
            break
        end

        local length = math.min(distance, 50)
        local nextPosition = root.Position + direction.Unit * length
        local tween = tweens:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(length / speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
            CFrame = CFrame.new(nextPosition)
        })
        local done = false
        local connection = tween.Completed:Connect(function() done = true end)
        tween:Play()

        repeat
            task.wait(0.12)
            if mob then attack(mob) end
        until done or not running or characterRoot() ~= root or currentQuest() ~= quest
            or (mob and (not mob.Parent or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0))

        if not done then tween:Cancel() end
        connection:Disconnect()
        if not running or characterRoot() ~= root then break end
    end
end

local noclip = runService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not running or not player.Character then return end
    for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
    end
end)

    close.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    close.Parent = panel
    close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        gui:Destroy()
        discordGui = nil
    end)

    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if camera then
        local function resize()
            local size = camera.ViewportSize
            scale.Scale = math.min(1, size.X / 395, size.Y / 250)
        end
        viewportConnection = camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(resize)
        resize()
    end
end

makeDiscordCard()

task.spawn(function()
    while running do
        task.wait(0.15)
        local root = characterRoot()
        local quest = currentQuest()
        if root and quest then
            equipMelee()
            startQuest(quest)
            local mob = findMob(quest.mob)
            if mob then
                moveTo(quest, mob)
            else
                moveTo(quest)
            end
        end
    end
end)

    noclip:Disconnect()

--[[
	Dimension Workbench (Rick & Morty style) - client-side, made for Delta  (v3)

	- Side panel (right edge): pick a dimension. Each one has its own look and
	  floating materials. Walk into a material to collect it. They respawn.
	- "Bag" button shows what you have collected.
	- Equip the "Workbench" tool: a bench appears in front of you. Pick an item
	  from the menu (it costs materials), then drag the glowing parts onto the blue outlines.
	- Finished items are added to your backpack.
	- Portal Gun: tap/click to shoot portal 1, then portal 2. Portals can even link
	  two different dimensions together.

	Re-executing the script cleans up the old run first.

	HOW TO ADD MORE
	  * New item:      add a parts list (like GUN / LANTERN), then add an entry to RECIPES.
	  * New material:  add to MATERIALS + MAT_ORDER + NODE_SHAPES, then use it in a dimension's nodes list.
	  * New dimension: copy one entry in DIMENSIONS (give it a new id, seed and look).
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse()
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

if env.__PortalGunCleanup then
	pcall(env.__PortalGunCleanup)
end

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SETTINGS
------------------------------------------------------------------
local SNAP_DIST = 1.5        -- how close a part must be to snap (studs)
local TOUCH_LIFT = 70        -- on touch, the part floats this many pixels above your finger
local BENCH_DISTANCE = 14    -- how far in front of you the workbench appears
local COLLECT_RADIUS = 6     -- how close you must be to pick up a material
local RESPAWN_TIME = 25      -- seconds until a collected material comes back
local PORTAL_W, PORTAL_H = 5, 7.5

local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 80)
local BLUE = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SHARED CONSTANTS
------------------------------------------------------------------
local WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(236, 238, 240)
local GREY = Color3.fromRGB(150, 155, 160)
local SILVER = Color3.fromRGB(205, 208, 212)
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 40)
local CYAN = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 255)
local PALE_GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(200, 255, 190)

local ROT = CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)      -- lays a cylinder along Z
local UPRIGHT = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)  -- stands a cylinder up (along Y)

local Block, Cyl, Ball = Enum.PartType.Block, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Enum.PartType.Ball
local Plastic, Metal, Neon, Glass = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.Material.Neon, Enum.Material.Glass

local function V(x, y, z) return Vector3.new(x, y, z) end

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- MATERIALS (what you collect)
------------------------------------------------------------------
local MATERIALS = {
	scrap   = { name = "Scrap Metal",   color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 175, 185) },
	circuit = { name = "Circuit Board", color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 210, 120) },
	fluid   = { name = "Portal Fluid",  color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 80) },
	goo     = { name = "Mutant Goo",    color = Color3.fromRGB(215, 255, 60) },
	crystal = { name = "Void Crystal",  color = Color3.fromRGB(175, 115, 255) },
	plasma  = { name = "Plasma Core",   color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 40) },
}
local MAT_ORDER = { "scrap", "circuit", "fluid", "goo", "crystal", "plasma" }

local inv = {}
for _, id in ipairs(MAT_ORDER) do inv[id] = 0 end

-- how each material looks floating in a dimension (parts are relative to the middle)
local NODE_SHAPES = {
	scrap = function(add)
		add(Cyl, V(0.35, 1.5, 1.5), CFrame.new(), Color3.fromRGB(165, 170, 180), Metal)
		add(Cyl, V(0.5, 0.6, 0.6), CFrame.new(), DARK, Metal)
		for _, o in ipairs({ V(0, 0.85, 0), V(0, -0.85, 0), V(0, 0, 0.85), V(0, 0, -0.85) }) do
			add(Block, V(0.35, 0.35, 0.35), CFrame.new(o), Color3.fromRGB(165, 170, 180), Metal)
		end
	end,
	circuit = function(add)
		add(Block, V(1.5, 0.14, 1.1), CFrame.new(), Color3.fromRGB(30, 140, 70), Plastic)
		add(Block, V(0.5, 0.12, 0.5), CFrame.new(0, 0.12, 0), DARK, Plastic)
		add(Block, V(0.12, 0.1, 0.12), CFrame.new(0.5, 0.1, 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 60), Neon)
		add(Block, V(0.12, 0.1, 0.12), CFrame.new(-0.5, 0.1, -0.3), Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 60), Neon)
	end,
	fluid = function(add)
		add(Cyl, V(1.3, 0.6, 0.6), UPRIGHT, Color3.fromRGB(210, 255, 220), Glass, 0.45)
		add(Cyl, V(0.9, 0.42, 0.42), CFrame.new(0, -0.15, 0) * UPRIGHT, GREEN, Neon)
		add(Cyl, V(0.2, 0.5, 0.5), CFrame.new(0, 0.72, 0) * UPRIGHT, DARK, Plastic)
	end,
	goo = function(add)
		add(Ball, V(0.95, 0.95, 0.95), CFrame.new(), Color3.fromRGB(215, 255, 60), Neon)
		add(Ball, V(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), CFrame.new(0.5, -0.25, 0.1), Color3.fromRGB(190, 240, 40), Neon)
		add(Ball, V(0.3, 0.3, 0.3), CFrame.new(-0.4, 0.3, 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(235, 255, 110), Neon)
	end,
	crystal = function(add)
		local c = Color3.fromRGB(175, 115, 255)
		add(Block, V(0.55, 1.7, 0.55), CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0), c, Neon)
		add(Block, V(0.35, 1.0, 0.35), CFrame.new(0.45, -0.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(140, 90, 230), Neon)
		add(Block, V(0.3, 0.9, 0.3), CFrame.new(-0.4, -0.35, 0.1) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -0.4), Color3.fromRGB(205, 160, 255), Neon)
	end,
	plasma = function(add)
		add(Ball, V(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), CFrame.new(), Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 150), Glass, 0.5)
		add(Ball, V(0.7, 0.7, 0.7), CFrame.new(), Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 30), Neon)
	end,
}

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ITEM PART LISTS (item frame: grip at origin, front is -Z, up is +Y)
------------------------------------------------------------------
local GUN = {
