	{ name = "Pommel",      label = "round pommel",   shape = Ball,  size = V(0.6, 0.6, 0.6),    offset = CFrame.new(0, -0.68, 0),             color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 72, 80), material = Metal },
	{ name = "Body",        label = "white body",     shape = Block, size = V(0.7, 0.7, 1.8),    offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.0, -0.35),           color = WHITE,      material = Plastic },
	{ name = "RearHousing", label = "rear housing",   shape = Block, size = V(0.8, 0.5, 0.45),   offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.0, 0.775),           color = GREY,       material = Metal },
	{ name = "BackCap",     label = "back cap",       shape = Cyl,   size = V(0.2, 0.42, 0.42),  offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.0, 1.1) * ROT,        color = DARK,       material = Plastic },
	{ name = "Display",     label = "display screen", shape = Block, size = V(0.4, 0.05, 0.3),   offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.275, 0.78),          color = CYAN,       material = Neon },
	{ name = "Barrel",      label = "barrel",         shape = Cyl,   size = V(1.3, 0.36, 0.36),  offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.0, -1.9) * ROT,      color = SILVER,     material = Metal },
	{ name = "RingA",       label = "first ring",     shape = Cyl,   size = V(0.12, 0.5, 0.5),   offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.0, -1.45) * ROT,     color = DARK,       material = Plastic },
	{ name = "RingB",       label = "second ring",    shape = Cyl,   size = V(0.12, 0.5, 0.5),   offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.0, -2.3) * ROT,      color = DARK,       material = Plastic },
	{ name = "EmitterTip",  label = "emitter tip",    shape = Cyl,   size = V(0.3, 0.62, 0.62),  offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.0, -2.7) * ROT,      color = DARK,       material = Plastic },
	{ name = "EmitterLens", label = "green lens",     shape = Cyl,   size = V(0.06, 0.44, 0.44), offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.0, -2.88) * ROT,     color = GREEN,      material = Neon },
	{ name = "DomeBase",    label = "dome base",      shape = Cyl,   size = V(0.14, 0.7, 0.7),   offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.42, -0.8) * UPRIGHT, color = GREY,       material = Metal },
	{ name = "Dome",        label = "glass dome",     shape = Ball,  size = V(0.8, 0.8, 0.8),    offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.8, -0.8),            color = GREEN,      material = Glass, transparency = 0.35 },
	{ name = "DomeCore",    label = "glowing core",   shape = Ball,  size = V(0.38, 0.38, 0.38), offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.8, -0.8),            color = PALE_GREEN, material = Neon },
	{ name = "SideButton",  label = "side button",    shape = Cyl,   size = V(0.1, 0.2, 0.2),    offset = CFrame.new(0.4, 1.0, 0.1),           color = GREEN,      material = Neon },
}

local LANTERN = {
	{ name = "Grip",  label = "grip",         shape = Cyl,  size = V(0.9, 0.3, 0.3),   offset = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * UPRIGHT,    color = DARK, material = Plastic },
	{ name = "Base",  label = "metal base",   shape = Cyl,  size = V(0.15, 1.0, 1.0),  offset = CFrame.new(0, 0.52, 0) * UPRIGHT, color = GREY, material = Metal },
	{ name = "Core",  label = "plasma core",  shape = Ball, size = V(0.6, 0.6, 0.6),   offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.15, 0),           color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 50), material = Neon },
	{ name = "Shell", label = "glass shell",  shape = Ball, size = V(1.1, 1.1, 1.1),   offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.15, 0),           color = Color3.fromRGB(190, 230, 255), material = Glass, transparency = 0.55 },
	{ name = "Cap",   label = "top cap",      shape = Cyl,  size = V(0.15, 0.8, 0.8),  offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.78, 0) * UPRIGHT, color = GREY, material = Metal },
	{ name = "Loop",  label = "hanging loop", shape = Cyl,  size = V(0.08, 0.5, 0.5),  offset = CFrame.new(0, 2.0, 0),            color = DARK, material = Plastic },
}

-- spots on the table where loose parts start (x, z on the table top)
local SLOTS = {
	{ -8.8, 3.2 }, { -6.4, 3.4 }, { -3.6, 3.2 }, { -0.2, 3.3 }, { 2.0, 3.5 },
	{ 3.8, 3.0 }, { 6.6, 3.2 }, { 8.9, 3.4 }, { 8.8, 1.2 }, { -8.8, 1.2 },
	{ -6.6, 1.0 }, { 6.4, 1.1 }, { 8.8, -1.4 }, { -8.8, -1.4 }, { -6.6, -1.6 },
	{ -4.5, -2.8 }, { -1.5, -3.0 }, { 1.5, -3.0 }, { 4.5, -2.8 },
}

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GENERIC HELPERS
------------------------------------------------------------------
local function scaleCF(cf, s)
	return CFrame.new(cf.Position * s) * (cf - cf.Position)
end

local function halfHeight(cf, size)
	return 0.5 * (math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y) * size.X + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y) * size.Y + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y) * size.Z)
end

local function hex(c)
	return ("#%02X%02X%02X"):format(math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
end

-- generic anchored part. collide/query default to false
local function newPart(parent, shape, size, cf, color, material, transparency, collide, query)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Shape = shape
	p.Size = size
	p.CFrame = cf
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material
	p.Transparency = transparency or 0
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = collide or false
	p.CanQuery = query or false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

local function makePart(def, scale)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = def.name
	p.Shape = def.shape
	p.Size = def.size * scale
	p.Color = def.color
	p.Material = def.material
	p.Transparency = def.transparency or 0
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	return p
end

local connections, objects = {}, {}
local function track(c) table.insert(connections, c) return c end
local function trackObj(o) table.insert(objects, o) return o end

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STATE
------------------------------------------------------------------
local inBench, ready, dragging, dragIsTouch, traveling = false, false, false, false, false
local step = 1
local active = nil                       -- { recipe = ... } while building an item
local owned = {}                         -- crafted items: owned[recipeId] = true
local benchBuilt = false
local benchModel, benchPivotLocal, buildFolder
local B = CFrame.new()                   -- workbench frame (origin = middle of table top, +Z faces you)
local camLocal = CFrame.new()
local targetsLocal, restYs, looseParts, ghosts = {}, {}, {}, {}
local highlight, renderConn, camTween
local pointerPos = Vector2.zero
local saved = {}
local portals = {}
local currentDim, homeCF = nil, nil      -- nil currentDim = your normal world
local giveTools, exitBench, refreshBag, refreshRecipeMenu, updateSideButtons

local portalFolder = trackObj(Instance.new("Folder"))
portalFolder.Name = "PortalGunPortals"
portalFolder.Parent = Workspace

local dimFolder = trackObj(Instance.new("Folder"))
dimFolder.Name = "PortalGunDimensions"
dimFolder.Parent = Workspace

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- UI
------------------------------------------------------------------
local gui = trackObj(Instance.new("ScreenGui"))
gui.Name = "PortalGunUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 20
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function round(inst, r)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 10)
	c.Parent = inst
end

local function pad(inst, n)
	local p = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	p.PaddingTop, p.PaddingBottom, p.PaddingLeft, p.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, n), UDim.new(0, n), UDim.new(0, n), UDim.new(0, n)
	p.Parent = inst
end

local function list(inst, gap, align)
	local l = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	l.Padding = UDim.new(0, gap)
	l.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	if align then l.HorizontalAlignment = align end
	l.Parent = inst
	return l
end

-- invisible full-screen catcher: receives every touch/click while building
local catcher = Instance.new("Frame")
catcher.Name = "InputCatcher"
catcher.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
catcher.BackgroundTransparency = 1
catcher.BorderSizePixel = 0
catcher.Active = true
catcher.Visible = false
catcher.ZIndex = 1
catcher.Parent = gui

local function makeLabel(className)
	local l = Instance.new(className)
	l.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26)
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	l.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	l.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	l.TextSize = 16
	l.TextWrapped = true
	l.Visible = false
	l.BorderSizePixel = 0
	l.ZIndex = 5
	l.Parent = gui
	round(l)
	return l
end

local panel = makeLabel("TextLabel")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 10)
panel.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 44)

local exitBtn = makeLabel("TextButton")
exitBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
exitBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16)
exitBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 40)
exitBtn.Text = "Exit"
exitBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 40, 40)

local cancelBtn = makeLabel("TextButton")
cancelBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
cancelBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -16)
cancelBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 40)
cancelBtn.Text = "Cancel build"
cancelBtn.TextSize = 14
cancelBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 60, 30)

local toastLabel = makeLabel("TextLabel")
toastLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
toastLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -90)
toastLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 38)
toastLabel.ZIndex = 8

local toastId = 0
local function toast(text)
	toastId += 1
	local id = toastId
	toastLabel.Text = text
	toastLabel.Visible = true
	task.delay(2.2, function()
		if toastId == id then toastLabel.Visible = false end
	end)
end

-- fade overlay for dimension travel (does not block input)
local fade = Instance.new("Frame")
fade.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
fade.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
fade.BackgroundTransparency = 1
fade.BorderSizePixel = 0
fade.Active = false
fade.ZIndex = 100
fade.Parent = gui

local function fadeTo(t, dur)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(fade, TweenInfo.new(dur), { BackgroundTransparency = t })
	tw:Play()
	tw.Completed:Wait()
end

-- ===== side panel: dimensions + bag =====
local side = Instance.new("Frame")
side.Name = "DimensionPanel"
side.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
side.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0)
side.Size = UDim2.new(0, 128, 0, 0)
side.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
side.BackgroundTransparency = 1
side.ZIndex = 6
side.Parent = gui
list(side, 6, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right)

local sideTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")

sideTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
sideTitle.Text = "DIMENSIONS"
sideTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 240)
sideTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
sideTitle.TextSize = 12
sideTitle.LayoutOrder = 0
sideTitle.ZIndex = 6
sideTitle.Parent = side

local sideButtons = {}
local function makeSideButton(text, color, order)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 32)
	b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.TextSize = 13
	b.Text = text
	b.LayoutOrder = order
	b.ZIndex = 6
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.Parent = side
	round(b, 8)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = color
	s.Thickness = 1.5
	s.Parent = b
	return b, s
end

-- bag panel (left of the side panel)
local bagPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
bagPanel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
bagPanel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -144, 0.5, 0)
bagPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 0)

bagPanel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26)
bagPanel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
bagPanel.BorderSizePixel = 0

bagPanel.ZIndex = 6
bagPanel.Parent = gui
round(bagPanel)
pad(bagPanel, 8)
list(bagPanel, 4)

local bagTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
bagTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
bagTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
bagTitle.Text = "Materials"
bagTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
bagTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
bagTitle.TextSize = 15
bagTitle.LayoutOrder = 0
bagTitle.ZIndex = 6
bagTitle.Parent = bagPanel

local bagRows = {}
for i, id in ipairs(MAT_ORDER) do
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.LayoutOrder = i
	row.ZIndex = 6
	row.Parent = bagPanel

	local swatch = Instance.new("Frame")
	swatch.Size = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 18)
	swatch.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2)
	swatch.BackgroundColor3 = MATERIALS[id].color
	swatch.BorderSizePixel = 0
	swatch.ZIndex = 6
	swatch.Parent = row
	round(swatch, 3)

	local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
	nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)

	nameLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	nameLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	nameLbl.TextSize = 13
	nameLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	nameLbl.ZIndex = 6
	nameLbl.Parent = row

	local countLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")

end

function refreshBag()
	for id, lbl in pairs(bagRows) do
		lbl.Text = tostring(inv[id])
	end
	if refreshRecipeMenu then refreshRecipeMenu() end
end

-- ===== workbench recipe menu (left side, only while at the bench) =====

local function getHumanoid()
	local ch = player.Character
	return ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local controls
local function setControls(enabled)
	if not controls then
		pcall(function()
			controls = require(player:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("PlayerModule", 3)):GetControls()
		end)
	end
	if controls then
		pcall(function()
			if enabled then controls:Enable() else controls:Disable() end
		end)
	end
end

local function canAfford(cost)
	for id, need in pairs(cost) do
		if (inv[id] or 0) < need then return false end
	end
	return true
end

local function pay(cost)
	for id, need in pairs(cost) do inv[id] -= need end
	refreshBag()
end

local function refund(cost)
	for id, need in pairs(cost) do inv[id] += need end
	refreshBag()
end

local function setCurrentDim(d)
	if currentDim == d then return end
	currentDim = d
	if env.__PortalGunApplyLook then env.__PortalGunApplyLook(d) end
	updateSideButtons()
end

local function openPortal(idx, pos, normal)
	local _, root = getHumanoid()
	local n = normal
	local center
	if math.abs(normal.Y) > 0.85 then
		-- floor / ceiling: stand the portal upright facing the player
		local flat = root and Vector3.new(root.Position.X - pos.X, 0, root.Position.Z - pos.Z) or Vector3.zero
		n = flat.Magnitude > 0.1 and flat.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
		local lift = normal.Y > 0 and PORTAL_H / 2 or -PORTAL_H / 2
		center = pos + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0) + n * 0.3
	else
		center = pos + normal * 0.2
	end
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(center, center + n) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0) -- cylinder axis (X) = normal

	if portals[idx] then
		portals[idx].model:Destroy()
		portals[idx] = nil
	end

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Portal" .. idx
	model.Parent = portalFolder

	local function disc(size, color, transparency)
		local d = newPart(model, Cyl, Vector3.new(size.X, 0.2, 0.2), cf, color, Neon, transparency, false, false)
		d.CastShadow = false
		TweenService:Create(d, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = size }):Play()
		return d
	end

	local outer = disc(V(0.3, PORTAL_H, PORTAL_W), GREEN, 0)
	disc(V(0.45, PORTAL_H * 0.82, PORTAL_W * 0.8), Color3.fromRGB(30, 170, 50), 0.1)
	local swirl = disc(V(0.6, PORTAL_H * 0.55, PORTAL_W * 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(190, 255, 150), 0.35)

	local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(GREEN)
	pe.LightEmission = 1
	pe.Rate = 50
	pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
	pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
	pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.5), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	pe.Parent = outer

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = GREEN
	light.Range = 16
	light.Brightness = 2
	light.Parent = outer

	-- remember which dimension this portal is in, so portals can link dimensions
	portals[idx] = { model = model, cf = cf, swirl = swirl, dim = currentDim }
end

local spin, tpCooldown = 0, 0
track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	spin += dt * 2.5
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local p = portals[i]
		if p and p.swirl.Parent then
			p.swirl.CFrame = p.cf * CFrame.Angles(spin * (i == 1 and 1 or -1), 0, 0)
		end
	end

	if os.clock() < tpCooldown then return end
	local _, root = getHumanoid()
	if not root then return end

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local a, b = portals[i], portals[3 - i]
		if a and b and a.dim == currentDim then
			local rel = a.cf:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
			if math.abs(rel.X) < 1.4 and math.abs(rel.Y) < PORTAL_H / 2 - 0.4 and math.abs(rel.Z) < PORTAL_W / 2 - 0.3 then
				local n = b.cf.RightVector
				local flat = Vector3.new(n.X, 0, n.Z)
				flat = flat.Magnitude > 0.05 and flat.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
				local exitPos = b.cf.Position + flat * 3.4 + Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 0)

				local params = RaycastParams.new()
				params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character, portalFolder }
				local down = Workspace:Raycast(exitPos, Vector3.new(0, -10, 0), params)
				if down then
					exitPos = Vector3.new(exitPos.X, down.Position.Y + 3.2, exitPos.Z)
				end

				if b.dim ~= currentDim then
					if not currentDim then homeCF = root.CFrame end
					setCurrentDim(b.dim)
				end
				root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(exitPos, exitPos + flat)
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				tpCooldown = os.clock() + 1
				break
			end
		end
	end
end))

local function beam(from, to)
	local len = (to - from).Magnitude
	if len < 0.1 then return end
	local b = newPart(portalFolder, Block, V(0.35, 0.35, len), CFrame.lookAt(from, to) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -len / 2), GREEN, Neon, 0, false, false)
	TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { Transparency = 1, Size = V(0.05, 0.05, len) }):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(b, 0.4)
end

local nextPortal, lastShot = 1, 0
local function firePortal(tool)
	if os.clock() - lastShot < 0.4 then return end
	lastShot = os.clock()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end

	local unit = mouse.UnitRay
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, portalFolder }
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(unit.Origin, unit.Direction * 800, params)

	local lens = tool:FindFirstChild("EmitterLens")
	local from = lens and lens.Position or (char.PrimaryPart and char.PrimaryPart.Position) or unit.Origin

	if not result then
		beam(from, unit.Origin + unit.Direction * 100)
		toast("Aim at a surface to open a portal")
		return
	end

	beam(from, result.Position)
	openPortal(nextPortal, result.Position, result.Normal)
	toast("Portal " .. nextPortal .. " opened")
	nextPortal = nextPortal % 2 + 1
end

local function buildHeldTool(toolName, parts, setup)
	local tool = trackObj(Instance.new("Tool"))
	tool.Name = toolName
	tool.ToolTip = toolName
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	tool.RequiresHandle = true

	-- invisible handle sits in the middle of the grip
	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Size = V(0.4, 0.4, 0.4)
	handle.Transparency = 1
	handle.CanCollide = false
	handle.Massless = true
	handle.Parent = tool

	for _, def in ipairs(parts) do
		local p = makePart(def, 1)
		p.Anchored = false
		p.Massless = true
		local w = Instance.new("Weld")
		w.Part0 = handle
		w.Part1 = p
		w.C0 = def.offset
		w.Parent = p
		p.Parent = tool
	end

	if setup then setup(tool) end
	return tool
end

	return buildHeldTool("Portal Gun", GUN, function(tool)

		glow.Parent = tool:FindFirstChild("DomeCore")
		tool.Activated:Connect(function() firePortal(tool) end)

local function spotFinder(rng, base, taken)
	return function(r)
		for _ = 1, 25 do
			local a = rng:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
			local dist = 16 + rng:NextNumber() * 100
			local x, z = base.X + math.cos(a) * dist, base.Z + math.sin(a) * dist
			local ok = true
			for _, t in ipairs(taken) do
				if (t.x - x) ^ 2 + (t.z - z) ^ 2 < (t.r + r + 1.5) ^ 2 then ok = false break end
			end
			if ok then
				table.insert(taken, { x = x, z = z, r = r })
				return Vector3.new(x, base.Y, z)
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
end

-- ===== atmosphere / lighting per dimension (local only) =====
local lightBackup, atmo, atmoCreated, atmoBackup, cc

local function applyLook(d)
	if not d then
		if lightBackup then
			for k, v in pairs(lightBackup) do pcall(function() Lighting[k] = v end) end
			lightBackup = nil
		end
		if atmo then
			if atmoCreated then
				atmo:Destroy()
			elseif atmoBackup then
				for k, v in pairs(atmoBackup) do pcall(function() atmo[k] = v end) end
			end
			atmo = nil
		end
		if cc then cc:Destroy() cc = nil end
		return
	end

	if not lightBackup then
		lightBackup = { ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime, Ambient = Lighting.Ambient, OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient, Brightness = Lighting.Brightness }
	end
	local L = d.look
	Lighting.ClockTime = L.clock
	Lighting.Ambient = L.ambient
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = L.outdoor
	Lighting.Brightness = L.brightness

	if not atmo then
		atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
		if atmo then
			atmoCreated = false
			atmoBackup = { Density = atmo.Density, Offset = atmo.Offset, Color = atmo.Color, Decay = atmo.Decay, Glare = atmo.Glare, Haze = atmo.Haze }
		else
			atmoCreated = true
			atmo = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
			atmo.Parent = Lighting
		end
	end
	atmo.Density = L.density
	atmo.Color = L.color
	atmo.Decay = L.decay
	atmo.Haze = L.haze
	atmo.Glare = L.glare

	if not cc then
		cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
		cc.Parent = Lighting
	end
	cc.TintColor = L.tint
	cc.Saturation = L.sat
	cc.Contrast = L.contrast
end
env.__PortalGunApplyLook = applyLook

local function buildNode(parent, matId, pos)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Node_" .. matId
	local pivot = newPart(model, Block, V(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), CFrame.new(), Color3.new(), Plastic, 1, false, false)
	model.PrimaryPart = pivot
	NODE_SHAPES[matId](function(shape, size, offset, color, material, transparency)
		newPart(model, shape, size, offset, color, material, transparency, false, false)
	end)
	model.Parent = parent
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
	return model
end

local function buildDimension(d)
	if d.built then return end
	d.built = true

	local rng = Random.new(d.seed)
	local base = Vector3.new(d.index * 1500, 3000, 0)
	d.base = base

	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Dim_" .. d.id
	folder.Parent = dimFolder

	-- island + glowing arrival pad
	local ground = newPart(folder, Cyl, V(6, 260, 260), CFrame.new(base - V(0, 3, 0)) * UPRIGHT, d.ground, d.groundMat, 0, true, true)
	ground.Name = "Ground"
	newPart(folder, Cyl, V(0.2, 12, 12), CFrame.new(base + V(0, 0.1, 0)) * UPRIGHT, d.color, Neon, 0.35, false, false)

	-- invisible wall so you can't walk off the edge
	for i = 0, 23 do
		local a = (i / 24) * math.pi * 2
		local pos = base + V(math.cos(a) * 129, 30, math.sin(a) * 129)
		newPart(folder, Block, V(36, 60, 2), CFrame.lookAt(pos, V(base.X, pos.Y, base.Z)), Color3.new(), Plastic, 1, true, false)
	end

	local taken = { { x = base.X, z = base.Z, r = 8 } }

	-- collectible materials
	d.nodes_built = {}
	local nodeFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	nodeFolder.Name = "Nodes"
	nodeFolder.Parent = folder
	for _, entry in ipairs(d.nodes) do
		local matId, count = entry[1], entry[2]
		for _ = 1, count do
			for _ = 1, 25 do
				local a = rng:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
				local dist = 12 + rng:NextNumber() * 105
				local x, z = base.X + math.cos(a) * dist, base.Z + math.sin(a) * dist
				local ok = true
				for _, t in ipairs(taken) do
					if (t.x - x) ^ 2 + (t.z - z) ^ 2 < (t.r + 2.5) ^ 2 then ok = false break end
				end
				if ok then
					table.insert(taken, { x = x, z = z, r = 2.5 })
					local pos = Vector3.new(x, base.Y + 3.2, z)
					table.insert(d.nodes_built, {
						mat = matId, pos = pos, phase = rng:NextNumber() * 6.28, active = true,
						folder = nodeFolder, model = buildNode(nodeFolder, matId, pos),
					})
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	d.decor({ folder = folder, rng = rng, base = base, spot = spotFinder(rng, base, taken) })
end

local function buildBench()
	if benchBuilt then return end
	benchBuilt = true

	benchModel = trackObj(Instance.new("Model"))
	benchModel.Name = "PortalWorkbenchScene"

	local function block(name, size, pos, color, material, transparency, shape)

			block("Leg", V(0.9, 2.6, 0.9), V(sx * 9.3, -2.1, sz * 3.9), darkWood, Enum.Material.Wood)

	block("ToolboxLid", V(2.7, 0.15, 1.4), V(-7.6, 1.25, -3.3), Color3.fromRGB(150, 30, 30), Metal)
	local mug = block("Mug", V(0.8, 0.7, 0.7), V(7.8, 0.4, -3.4), Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), Plastic, 0, Cyl)
	mug.CFrame = CFrame.new(7.8, 0.4, -3.4) * UPRIGHT
	block("Wrench", V(0.25, 2.6, 0.12), V(5.5, 3.6, -4.45), Color3.fromRGB(190, 195, 200), Metal)
	block("Hammerhead", V(1.3, 0.6, 0.25), V(3.2, 4.2, -4.45), Color3.fromRGB(80, 82, 90), Metal)
	block("HammerHandle", V(0.25, 2.4, 0.2), V(3.2, 3.0, -4.45), darkWood, Enum.Material.Wood)

	l.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 210)
	l.Parent = lamp

	benchModel.PrimaryPart = top
	benchPivotLocal = top.CFrame
	camLocal = CFrame.lookAt(V(0, 6, 12), V(0, 1.8, 0))
end

-- puts the bench on the ground in front of the player, facing them
local function computeFrame()
	local _, root = getHumanoid()
	local pos = root and root.Position or V(0, 5, 0)
	local look = root and root.CFrame.LookVector or V(0, 0, -1)
	local f = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	f = f.Magnitude > 0.05 and f.Unit or V(0, 0, -1)

	local p = pos + f * BENCH_DISTANCE
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character, portalFolder, benchModel }
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(p.X, pos.Y + 2, p.Z), V(0, -60, 0), params)
	local groundY = hit and hit.Position.Y or (pos.Y - 3)

	local origin = Vector3.new(p.X, groundY + 3.4, p.Z)
	return CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + f)
end

local function targetWorld(i)
	return B * targetsLocal[i]
end

local function clearStepVisuals()
	if highlight then
		highlight:Destroy()
		highlight = nil
	end
	for i, g in pairs(ghosts) do
		g:Destroy()
		ghosts[i] = nil
	end
end

local function clearBuild()
	clearStepVisuals()
	if buildFolder then buildFolder:Destroy() buildFolder = nil end
	targetsLocal, restYs, looseParts, ghosts = {}, {}, {}, {}
	active = nil
	step = 1
	dragging = false
end

local function showMenu()
	panel.Text = "Workbench: choose an item to craft"
	cancelBtn.Visible = false
	refreshRecipeMenu()
	menu.Visible = true
end

local function showStep()
	clearStepVisuals()
	if not active then return end
	local recipe = active.recipe
	if step > #recipe.parts then return end
	local def = recipe.parts[step]

	local g = makePart(def, recipe.scale)
	g.Name = "Ghost"
	g.Color = BLUE
	g.Material = Neon
	g.Transparency = 0.55
	g.CFrame = targetWorld(step)
	g.Parent = buildFolder
	ghosts[step] = g

	pcall(function()
		local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.Adornee = looseParts[step]
		hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0)
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
		hl.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.Parent = looseParts[step]
		highlight = hl
	end)

	panel.Text = ("%s - part %d/%d: drag the %s onto the blue outline"):format(recipe.name, step, #recipe.parts, def.label)
end

local function startBuild(recipe)
	clearBuild()
	buildFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	buildFolder.Name = "Build"
	buildFolder.Parent = benchModel
	active = { recipe = recipe }
	step = 1

	for i, def in ipairs(recipe.parts) do
		local target = recipe.asm * scaleCF(def.offset, recipe.scale)
		targetsLocal[i] = target
		local p = makePart(def, recipe.scale)
		restYs[i] = halfHeight(target, p.Size) + 0.03
		local slot = SLOTS[i]
		p.CFrame = B * (CFrame.new(slot[1], restYs[i], slot[2]) * (target - target.Position))
		p.Parent = buildFolder
		looseParts[i] = p
	end

	menu.Visible = false
	cancelBtn.Visible = true
	showStep()
end

local function finishCrafting(recipe)
	owned[recipe.id] = true
	panel.Text = recipe.name .. " crafted!"
	task.delay(1.3, function()
		giveTools()
		toast(recipe.name .. " added to your backpack")
		clearBuild()
		local hum = getHumanoid()
		if hum then hum:UnequipTools() end
		exitBench()
	end)
end

local function snapPart()
	local i = step
	local part = looseParts[i]
	local recipe = active.recipe
	dragging = false

	TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { CFrame = targetWorld(i) }):Play()

	local hl = highlight
	highlight = nil
	if hl then
		hl.FillColor = BLUE
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.2
		TweenService:Create(hl, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { FillTransparency = 1, OutlineTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		Debris:AddItem(hl, 0.6)
	end

	if ghosts[i] then
		ghosts[i]:Destroy()
		ghosts[i] = nil
	end

	step = i + 1
	if step > #recipe.parts then
		finishCrafting(recipe)
	else
		showStep()
	end
end

local function dropPart()
	if not dragging then return end
	dragging = false
	local part = looseParts[step]
	if not part or not targetsLocal[step] then return end

	if (part.Position - targetWorld(step).Position).Magnitude < SNAP_DIST then
		snapPart()
	else
		-- let it fall back onto the table
		local rest = Vector3.new(part.Position.X, B.Y + restYs[step], part.Position.Z)
		TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Position = rest }):Play()
	end
end

local function planeHit(screenPos, worldY)
	local ray = Workspace.CurrentCamera:ScreenPointToRay(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
	local d = ray.Direction
	if math.abs(d.Y) < 0.01 then return nil end
	local t = (worldY - ray.Origin.Y) / d.Y
	if t < 0 then return nil end
	return ray.Origin + d * t
end

local function onRender()
	if not ready then return end
	local part, ghost, tLocal = looseParts[step], ghosts[step], targetsLocal[step]
	if not (part and tLocal) then return end
	local tWorld = B * tLocal

	if dragging then
		local p = dragIsTouch and (pointerPos + Vector2.new(0, -TOUCH_LIFT)) or pointerPos
		local hit = planeHit(p, tWorld.Position.Y)
		if hit then
			local lp = B:PointToObjectSpace(hit)
			local goal = B:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(math.clamp(lp.X, -9.4, 9.4), tLocal.Position.Y, math.clamp(lp.Z, -4.1, 4.1)))
			part.Position = part.Position:Lerp(goal, 0.45)
		end
	end

	if ghost then
		local near = dragging and (part.Position - ghost.Position).Magnitude < SNAP_DIST
		ghost.Transparency = near and 0.2 or (0.55 + 0.12 * math.sin(os.clock() * 4))
	end
end

local function tryCraft(recipe)
	if owned[recipe.id] then
		toast("You already crafted the " .. recipe.name)
		return
	end
	if not canAfford(recipe.cost) then
		toast("Not enough materials - explore the dimensions!")
		return
	end
	pay(recipe.cost)
	startBuild(recipe)
end

function refreshRecipeMenu()
	for _, c in ipairs(menu:GetChildren()) do
		if c:GetAttribute("RecipeButton") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	for i, r in ipairs(RECIPES) do
		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		btn:SetAttribute("RecipeButton", true)
		btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		btn.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 48)
		btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		btn.RichText = true
		btn.TextWrapped = true
		btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		btn.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
		btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		btn.TextSize = 13
		btn.LayoutOrder = i
		btn.ZIndex = 6

		local lines = { "<b>" .. r.name .. "</b>" }
		if owned[r.id] then
			table.insert(lines, '<font color="#8AD4FF">Crafted - check your backpack</font>')
		else
			for _, id in ipairs(MAT_ORDER) do
				local need = r.cost[id]
				if need then
					local have = inv[id]
					table.insert(lines, ('<font color="%s">%s %d/%d</font>'):format(have >= need and "#7CFF7C" or "#FF8080", MATERIALS[id].name, have, need))
				end
			end
			if canAfford(r.cost) then
				table.insert(lines, '<font color="#FFE066"><b>Tap to build</b></font>')
			end
		end
		btn.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")

		btn.Parent = menu
		round(btn, 8)
		pad(btn, 8)
		btn.Activated:Connect(function() tryCraft(r) end)
	end
end

local function enterBench()
	if inBench then return end
	buildBench()
	inBench = true
	ready = false
	dragging = false

	B = computeFrame()
	benchModel.Parent = Workspace
	benchModel:PivotTo(B * benchPivotLocal)

	local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local hum = getHumanoid()
	saved.fov = cam.FieldOfView
	if hum then
		saved.walk, saved.jp, saved.jh = hum.WalkSpeed, hum.JumpPower, hum.JumpHeight
		hum.WalkSpeed = 0
		hum.JumpPower = 0
		hum.JumpHeight = 0
	end
	setControls(false)
	cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable

	side.Visible = false
	bagPanel.Visible = false
	panel.Visible = true
	exitBtn.Visible = true
	catcher.Visible = true
	if active then
		cancelBtn.Visible = true
		showStep()
	else
		showMenu()
	end

	camTween = TweenService:Create(cam, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
		CFrame = B * camLocal,
		FieldOfView = 55,
	})
	camTween:Play()
	task.delay(1.3, function()
		if inBench then ready = true end
	end)

	renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(onRender)
end

function exitBench()
	if not inBench then return end
	inBench, ready = false, false

	if dragging then
		dragging = false
		local part = looseParts[step]
		if part and restYs[step] then
			part.Position = Vector3.new(part.Position.X, B.Y + restYs[step], part.Position.Z)
		end
	end

	if camTween then camTween:Cancel() end
	if renderConn then
		renderConn:Disconnect()
		renderConn = nil
	end
	panel.Visible = false
	exitBtn.Visible = false
	cancelBtn.Visible = false
	menu.Visible = false
	catcher.Visible = false
	side.Visible = true

	local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local hum = getHumanoid()
	if hum then
		hum.WalkSpeed = saved.walk or 16
		hum.JumpPower = saved.jp or 50
		hum.JumpHeight = saved.jh or 7.2
		cam.CameraSubject = hum
	end
	setControls(true)
	cam.FieldOfView = saved.fov or 70
	cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	if benchModel then benchModel.Parent = nil end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- WORKBENCH TOOL + GIVING TOOLS
------------------------------------------------------------------
local function createWorkbenchTool()
	local tool = trackObj(Instance.new("Tool"))
	tool.Name = "Workbench"
	tool.ToolTip = "Craft items"
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	tool.RequiresHandle = false
	tool.Equipped:Connect(enterBench)
	tool.Unequipped:Connect(exitBench)
	return tool
end

local function hasTool(name)
	local bp = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	return (bp and bp:FindFirstChild(name)) or (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(name))
end

function giveTools()
	local bp = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
	if not hasTool("Workbench") then
		createWorkbenchTool().Parent = bp
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(RECIPES) do
		if owned[r.id] and not hasTool(r.toolName) then
			r.createTool().Parent = bp
		end
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- INPUT: touch/click and drag anywhere to move the glowing part
------------------------------------------------------------------
local function isPointer(input)
	local t = input.UserInputType
	return t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

local function startDrag(input)
	if not inBench or not ready or dragging then return end
	if not looseParts[step] then return end
	dragging = true
	dragIsTouch = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	pointerPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
end

local function moveDrag(input)
	if not dragging then return end
	local t = input.UserInputType
	if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		pointerPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
	end
end

track(catcher.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if isPointer(input) then startDrag(input) end
end))
track(catcher.InputChanged:Connect(moveDrag))
track(catcher.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if isPointer(input) then dropPart() end
end))

-- fallbacks in case the finger/mouse leaves the catcher
track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(moveDrag))
track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and isPointer(input) then dropPart() end
end))

track(exitBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	local hum = getHumanoid()
	if hum then hum:UnequipTools() end
	exitBench()
end))

track(cancelBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	if not active then return end
	refund(active.recipe.cost)
	clearBuild()
	toast("Build cancelled - materials refunded")
	showMenu()
end))

------------------------------------------------------------------
track(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	exitBench()
	currentDim = nil
	applyLook(nil)
	updateSideButtons()
	task.wait(0.8)
	giveTools()
end))

env.__PortalGunCleanup = function()
	exitBench()
	if currentDim and homeCF then
		local _, root = getHumanoid()
		if root then root.CFrame = homeCF end
	end
	currentDim = nil
	applyLook(nil)
	for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
		pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
	end
	for _, o in ipairs(objects) do
		pcall(function() o:Destroy() end)
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(RECIPES) do
		for _, name in ipairs({ r.toolName }) do
			local bp = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			if bp and bp:FindFirstChild(name) then bp[name]:Destroy() end
			if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(name) then player.Character[name]:Destroy() end
		end
	end
	for _, name in ipairs({ "Workbench" }) do
		local bp = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if bp and bp:FindFirstChild(name) then bp[name]:Destroy() end
		if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(name) then player.Character[name]:Destroy() end
	end
	env.__PortalGunApplyLook = nil
end

-- ==================================================
-- AUTO-DETECTION RESPONSIVE MOBILE SCALER ENGINE
-- ==================================================
local function makeAdaptive(frame, baseW, baseH)
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	uiScale.Parent = frame
	local function adjustLayout()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera then
			local view = camera.ViewportSize
			local scaleX = view.X / (baseW + 20)
			local scaleY = view.Y / (baseH + 20)
			local finalScale = math.min(scaleX, scaleY, 1)
			uiScale.Scale = finalScale
		end
	end
	if workspace.CurrentCamera then
		workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(adjustLayout)
	end
	adjustLayout()
end

-- ==================================================
-- INTERACTIVE SMOOTH HOVER / CLICK ENGINE
-- ==================================================
local function addSmoothInteractions(btn, baseColor, hoverColor, scaleUp)
	scaleUp = scaleUp or 1.05
	local origSize = btn.Size
	
	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			BackgroundColor3 = hoverColor or baseColor,
			Size = UDim2.new(origSize.X.Scale, origSize.X.Offset * scaleUp, origSize.Y.Scale, origSize.Y.Offset * scaleUp)
		}):Play()
	end)
	
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			BackgroundColor3 = baseColor,
			Size = origSize
		}):Play()
	end)
end

local smallCapsMap = {
	["a"] = "ᴀ", ["b"] = "ʙ", ["c"] = "ᴄ", ["d"] = "ᴅ", ["e"] = "ᴇ", ["f"] = "ꜰ", ["g"] = "ɢ", ["h"] = "ʜ",

	["q"] = "ǫ", ["r"] = "ʀ", ["s"] = "s", ["t"] = "ᴛ", ["u"] = "ᴜ", ["v"] = "ᴠ", ["w"] = "ᴡ", ["x"] = "x",
	["y"] = "ʏ", ["z"] = "ᴢ",
	["A"] = "ᴀ", ["B"] = "ʙ", ["C"] = "ᴄ", ["D"] = "ᴅ", ["E"] = "ᴇ", ["F"] = "ꜰ", ["G"] = "ɢ", ["H"] = "ʜ",
	["I"] = "ɪ", ["J"] = "ᴊ", ["K"] = "ᴋ", ["L"] = "ʟ", ["M"] = "ᴍ", ["N"] = "ɴ", ["O"] = "ᴏ", ["P"] = "ᴘ",
	["Q"] = "ǫ", ["R"] = "ʀ", ["S"] = "s", ["T"] = "ᴛ", ["U"] = "ᴜ", ["V"] = "ᴠ", ["W"] = "ᴡ", ["X"] = "x",
	["Y"] = "ʏ", ["Z"] = "ᴢ"
}
local function toSmallCaps(str)
	local result = ""
	local inTag = false
	for i = 1, #str do
		local char = str:sub(i, i)
		if char == "<" then inTag = true end
		if inTag then
			result = result .. char
		else
			result = result .. (smallCapsMap[char] or char)
		end
		if char == ">" then inTag = false end
	end
	return result
end

-- ==================================================
-- COLOR LOOP HARMONIZER
-- ==================================================
local function getThemeColor(speedMultiplier)
	local colors = {
		Color3.fromRGB(40, 0, 10),
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 15, 45),
		Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 60),
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 120)
	}
	local t = (os.clock() * (speedMultiplier or 1.2)) % #colors
	local index = math.floor(t) + 1
	local nextIndex = (index % #colors) + 1
	local alpha = t - math.floor(t)
	local smoothAlpha = (1 - math.cos(alpha * math.pi)) / 2
	return colors[index]:Lerp(colors[nextIndex], smoothAlpha)
end

local function applyGradientWave(strokeInstance)
	if not strokeInstance then return end
	local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient", strokeInstance)
	gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, SharinganDarkRed),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, SharinganRed),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 180))
	})
	task.spawn(function()
		local rotation = 0
		while strokeInstance and strokeInstance.Parent do
			rotation = (rotation + 2.5) % 360
			gradient.Rotation = rotation
			task.wait(0.015)
		end
	end)
end

local function fadeInFrame(targetFrame)
	targetFrame.Visible = true
	TweenService:Create(targetFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.05}):Play()
	for _, child in pairs(targetFrame:GetDescendants()) do
		if child:IsA("UIStroke") and child.Name ~= "MainLoopingStroke" and child.Name ~= "RGBStroke" then
			TweenService:Create(child, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
		elseif child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			TweenService:Create(child, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
		elseif child:IsA("TextBox") or child:IsA("TextButton") or child:IsA("ImageButton") then
			local targetBgTrans = (child:IsA("TextBox") or child:IsA("TextButton")) and 0 or 1
			if child.Name == "SettingsFrame" or child.Name == "StandaloneChatWindow" then targetBgTrans = 0 end
			TweenService:Create(child, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = targetBgTrans, TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
		elseif child:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			TweenService:Create(child, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {ImageTransparency = 0}):Play()
		end
	end
end

local function fadeOutFrame(targetFrame)
	TweenService:Create(targetFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
	for _, child in pairs(targetFrame:GetDescendants()) do
		if child:IsA("UIStroke") then
			TweenService:Create(child, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		elseif child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			TweenService:Create(child, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		elseif child:IsA("TextBox") or child:IsA("TextButton") or child:IsA("ImageButton") then
			TweenService:Create(child, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		elseif child:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			TweenService:Create(child, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {ImageTransparency = 1}):Play()
		end
	end
end

local function makeMovable(element)
	task.spawn(function()
		local dragging = false
		local dragInput, dragStart, startPos
		element.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging = true
				dragStart = input.Position
				startPos = element.Position
				input.Changed:Connect(function()
					if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
						dragging = false
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
		element.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragInput = input
			end
		end)
		UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if input == dragInput and dragging then
				local delta = input.Position - dragStart
				element.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function getUniqueRandomWords(sourceTable, targetAmount)
	local indices = {}
	local chosenWords = {}
	while #chosenWords < targetAmount do
		local randIndex = math.random(1, #sourceTable)
		if not indices[randIndex] then
			indices[randIndex] = true
			table.insert(chosenWords, string.upper(sourceTable[randIndex]))
		end
		if #chosenWords >= #sourceTable then break end
	end
	return table.concat(chosenWords, " ")
end

local function send(msg)
	pcall(function()
		if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
			local ch = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
			if ch then
				ch:SendAsync(msg)
			end
		else
			local legacyChat = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
			if legacyChat and legacyChat:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest") then
				legacyChat.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, "All")
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function runSpamLoop()
	task.spawn(function()
		local cycleIdx = 1
		local globalMessageCounter = 0
		local standaloneModeCycleCounter = 1
		while running do
			local sp = tonumber(speed.Text) or 0.8
			for i, b in ipairs(names) do
				if not running then break end
				if b.Text ~= "" then
					if megaAntiTagMode and megaAntiTagTriggeredLoop then
						selected = prefixes[megaPrefixIndex]
						megaPrefixIndex = megaPrefixIndex + 1
						if megaPrefixIndex > #prefixes then
							megaPrefixIndex = 1
							currentActiveAutomatedMode = currentActiveAutomatedMode + 1
							if currentActiveAutomatedMode > 3 then currentActiveAutomatedMode = 1 end
							resetAllToggles()
							if currentActiveAutomatedMode == 1 then
								selectTmxMareVisual()
							elseif currentActiveAutomatedMode == 2 then
								selectAnimalKudaiVisual()
							else
								selectWord9Visual()
							end
						end
					elseif modesCycleMode and not megaAntiTagTriggeredLoop then
						resetAllToggles()
						if standaloneModeCycleCounter == 1 then
							selectTmxMareVisual()
						elseif standaloneModeCycleCounter == 2 then
							selectAnimalKudaiVisual()
						else
							selectWord9Visual()
						end
						standaloneModeCycleCounter = standaloneModeCycleCounter >= 3 and 1 or standaloneModeCycleCounter + 1
					end
					local currentPrefix = selected
					if cycleMode and not megaAntiTagTriggeredLoop and not megaAntiTagMode and not antiTagMode then
						currentPrefix = prefixes[cycleIdx]
						cycleIdx = cycleIdx >= #prefixes and 1 or cycleIdx + 1
					elseif not megaAntiTagTriggeredLoop and not megaAntiTagMode and not antiTagMode then
						currentPrefix = lastUserSelectedPrefix
					end
					local limit = (currentPrefix == "@") and 110 or 80
					local finalP = string.rep(currentPrefix, math.ceil(limit/#currentPrefix)):sub(1,limit)
					local outputPayload = ""
					local targetDisplay = b.Text:upper()
					if emojiMode then
						local count = math.random(1, 2)
						local block = ""
						for _ = 1, count do
							block = block .. targetEmojis[math.random(#targetEmojis)]
						end
						targetDisplay = targetDisplay .. " " .. block
					end
					if animalKudaiMode then
						local rWords = getUniqueRandomWords(animalPool, 5)

					elseif tmxMareMode then

					elseif word9Mode then

						outputPayload = "["..finalP.."] ["..targetDisplay.."] TMx mai " .. rWords
					end
					if outputPayload ~= "" then
						globalMessageCounter = globalMessageCounter + 1
						if globalMessageCounter % 5 == 0 then
							send("@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@ [S C R I P T] BY N S S [ THE COMEBACK OF NSS ]...")
							task.wait(sp)

						send(outputPayload)

			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	end)

local function cleanOrbTracker(playerInstance)
	if activeTrackers[playerInstance] then
		local tr = activeTrackers[playerInstance]
		tr.Running = false
		if tr.Connection then pcall(function() tr.Connection:Disconnect() end) end
		if tr.Core then pcall(function() tr.Core:Destroy() end) end
		if tr.Aura then pcall(function() tr.Aura:Destroy() end) end
		if tr.Rings then
			for _, ring in ipairs(tr.Rings) do
				for _, part in ipairs(ring) do
					pcall(function() part:Destroy() end)
				end
			end
		end
		activeTrackers[playerInstance] = nil
	end
end

		fire.Parent = auraPart
		local ringCount = 4
		local shardCount = 10
		for r = 1, ringCount do

			end

		local connection
		connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			if not tracker.Running or not char.Parent or not hrp or not hrp.Parent then

			local targetPos = hrp.Position - hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 4.5 + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
			smooth = smooth:Lerp(targetPos, 0.12)
			core.Position = smooth
			auraPart.Position = smooth
			local pulse = math.sin(t * 3) * 0.15 + 1
			core.Size = Vector3.new(4,4,4) * pulse
			for r = 1, ringCount do

				local radius = 2.8 + (r * 0.4)

        beam.Attachment1 = b
        beam.Width0 = 0.07

    end

    hum.Died:Connect(function()
        for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do

                    math.random(-25, 25),

                )
                Debris:AddItem(part, 4)
            end
        end
        Debris:AddItem(model, 4)
    end)

    return model
end

local function clearNPCs()
    for _, npc in ipairs(npcFolder:GetChildren()) do
        npc:Destroy()
    end
end

--==================================================
-- FPS BOOST
--==================================================

local fpsBoostEnabled = false
local oldLighting

local function setFPSBoost(state)
    if fpsBoostEnabled == state then return end
    fpsBoostEnabled = state

    if state then
        oldLighting = {
            GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
            FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
            Brightness = Lighting.Brightness
        }

        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
        Lighting.Brightness = 2
    elseif oldLighting then
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = oldLighting.GlobalShadows
        Lighting.FogEnd = oldLighting.FogEnd
        Lighting.Brightness = oldLighting.Brightness
        oldLighting = nil
    end
end

--==================================================
-- SHIFT LOCK
--==================================================

local function setShiftLock(state)
    shiftLockEnabled = state
    local hum = getHumanoid()

    if hum then
        if state then
            oldAutoRotate = hum.AutoRotate
            hum.AutoRotate = false
        else
            hum.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate
        end
    end

    UIS.MouseBehavior = state
        and Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        or Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
end

--==================================================
-- WALK / JUMP SETTINGS
--==================================================

local function setWalkSpeed(value)
    walkSpeed = math.clamp(value, 0, 200)
    local hum = getHumanoid()
    if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = walkSpeed end
end

local function setJumpPower(value)
    jumpPower = math.clamp(value, 0, 200)
    local hum = getHumanoid()
    if hum then
        hum.UseJumpPower = true
        hum.JumpPower = jumpPower
    end
end

--==================================================
-- MAIN UPDATE LOOP
--==================================================

local renderConnection

renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    local root = getRoot()
    local character = getCharacter()

    if noclipEnabled and character then
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                if oldCollisions[part] == nil then
                    oldCollisions[part] = part.CanCollide
                end
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    if flyEnabled and root and flyVelocity and flyGyro then
        local camCF = camera.CFrame

        local direction =
            camCF.RightVector * stickVector.X
            + camCF.LookVector * (-stickVector.Y)
            + Vector3.new(0, verticalDirection, 0)

        if direction.Magnitude > 1 then
            direction = direction.Unit
        end

        flyVelocity.Velocity = direction * flySpeed

        flyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
            root.Position,
            root.Position + camCF.LookVector
        )
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- RESPAWN
--==================================================

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    restoreNoclip()

    task.wait(1)

    local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if hum then
        hum.WalkSpeed = walkSpeed
        hum.UseJumpPower = true
        hum.JumpPower = jumpPower

        if shiftLockEnabled then
            oldAutoRotate = hum.AutoRotate
            hum.AutoRotate = false
        end
    end

    if flyEnabled then
        startFly()
    end
end)

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local function notify(text, duration)
	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")
	notif.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 36)
	notif.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notif.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	notif.ClipsDescendants = true
	notif.Parent = notifications
	
	local nCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	nCorner.Parent = notif
	
	local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	nStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 95)
	nStroke.Thickness = 1
	nStroke.Transparency = 1
	nStroke.Parent = notif
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 210)
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextTransparency = 1
	label.Parent = notif
	
	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)
end

local visible = false
local animating = false

local function toggleGui()
	if animating then return end
	animating = true
	visible = not visible
	
	local targetPos = visible and UDim2.new(1, -290, 0.5, -190) or UDim2.new(1, 300, 0.5, -190)
	
	TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = targetPos
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(0.35)
	animating = false
end

hideBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleGui)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		toggleGui()
	end
end)

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		task.spawn(applyForceField, plr, char)
	end)
end)

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, char)
end)

local holding = false

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or not getgenv().StretchConfig.AutoSprint then return end
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(true, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = true
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey and holding then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(false, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = false
	end
end)

local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.StretchEnabled then return end
	
	local cfg = getgenv().StretchConfig
	Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(
		0, 0, 0,
		1, 0, 0,
		0, cfg.Scale, 0,
		0, 0, 1
	)
end)

task.spawn(optimizeGame)
notify("Screen Stretch • Press P", 3)

local function fireproximityprompt(Obj, Amount, Skip)
    if Obj.ClassName == "ProximityPrompt" then 
        Amount = Amount or 1
        local PromptTime = Obj.HoldDuration
        if Skip then 
            Obj.HoldDuration = 0
        end
        for i = 1, Amount do 
            Obj:InputHoldBegin()
            if not Skip then 
                wait(Obj.HoldDuration)
            end
            Obj:InputHoldEnd()
        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else 
        error("userdata<ProximityPrompt> expected")
    end
end

    return startColor:Lerp(endColor, alpha)

-- Tempo de transição (em segundos)

    local endTime = startTime + transitionTime

    local endColor = randomColor()
    
    while tick() < endTime do
        local elapsedTime = tick() - startTime
        local alpha = elapsedTime / transitionTime
        
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Color = lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
                part.Transparency = 0.25
                part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField -- Aqui está a linha que adiciona o material ForceField
            end
        end
        
        wait()
    end
end

Section3:Button({
   Text = "Aim",
   Callback = function()
-- Credit Dollynho --

local fov = 36
local maxDistance = 350
local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)
    end
    
    if closest then
        local part = closest.Character[aimPart]
        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)
        end
})

local function formatNumber(n)
    local formatted = tostring(n)
    local k
    while true do
        formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2')
        if k == 0 then break end
    end
    return formatted
end

local function checkCashRegister()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #cashRegisters do
        local item = cashRegisters[i]
        local openPart = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
        if openPart then
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = openPart.CFrame
            robEvent:FireServer("Register", {
                Part = item:FindFirstChild("Union"),
                OpenPart = openPart,
                ActiveValue = item:FindFirstChild("Active"),
                Active = true
            })
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function checkSafe()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #safes do
        local item = safes[i]
        if item:FindFirstChild("Amount") and item.Amount.Value > 0 then
            local safePart = item:FindFirstChild("Safe")
            if safePart then
                humanoidRootPart.CFrame = safePart.CFrame
                local openFlag = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
                if openFlag and openFlag.Value then

                else
                    local openSafe = item:FindFirstChild("OpenSafe")
                    if openSafe then
                        openSafe:FireServer("Completed")
                    end
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                end
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

local function rawlength(tbl)
 local a = 0
 for i, v in pairs(tbl) do
  a = a + 1
 end
 return a
end

local function ToPairsLoop(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns2) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)
            return p.format:format(var1, var2, tbl)
        end)
    end
    return code
end

local function SafeOverride(a, b, c) --[[ Index, Data, Should override ]]
    if getgenv()[a] and not c then return 1 end
    getgenv()[a] = b

    return 2
end

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)
            return p.format:format(var, var, value)
        end)
    end
    code = ToPairsLoop(code)
    return code
end

    local self = setmetatable({}, Queue)
    self.elements = {}
    return self

function Queue:Queue(element)
    table.insert(self.elements, element)
end

function Queue:Update()
    if #self.elements == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return table.remove(self.elements, 1)
end

    return #self.elements == 0
end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)
    local letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) 
        local r,b='',x:byte()
        for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(b%2^i-b%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])
end
funcs.base64.decode = function(data)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

 local key = ''
 local a = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
 for i = 1, optionalSize or 32 do local n = math.random(1, #a) key = key .. a:sub(n, n) end

end

funcs.crypt.encrypt = function(a, b)
 local result = {}
 a = tostring(a) b = tostring(b)
 for i = 1, #a do
    local byte = string.byte(a, i)
    local keyByte = string.byte(b, (i - 1) % #b + 1)
    table.insert(result, string.char(bit32.bxor(byte, keyByte)))
 end
 return table.concat(result)
end

funcs.writefile = function(path, content)
 local Path = path:split('/')
 local CurrentPath = {}
 for i = 1, #Path do
  local a = Path[i]
  CurrentPath[i] = a
  if not files[a] and i ~= #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = {}
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/') .. '/'] = files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')]
  elseif i == #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = tostring(content)
  end
 end
end

funcs.listfiles = function(path)
    if not path or path == '' then
     local Files = {}
     for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if #i:split('/') == 1 then table.insert(Files, i) end
     end
     return Files
    end
    if type(files[path]) ~= 'table' then return error(path .. ' is not a folder.') end
    local Files = {}
    for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if startswith(i, path .. '/') and not endswith(i, '/') and i ~= path and #i:split('/') == (#path:split('/') + 1) then table.insert(Files, i) end
    end
    return Files
end

    local baseProps = {
     Visible = false,
     Color = Color3.new(0,0,0),
     ClassName = nil
    }
    if Type == 'Line' then
        local a = Instance.new("Frame", Instance.new("ScreenGui", DrawingDict))
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Thickness = 1,
            From = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            To = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Transparency = 0,
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateLine = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             local from = self.From
             local to = self.To
             local distance = (to - from).Magnitude
             local angle = math.deg(math.atan2(to.Y - from.Y, to.X - from.X))

             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, self.Thickness)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, from.X, 0, from.Y)
             a.Rotation = angle
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Thickness' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Size = UDim2.new(0, (self.To - self.From).Magnitude, 0, value)
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
            elseif key == 'Transparency' and typeof(value) == 'number' and value <= 1 then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - value
            elseif key == 'From' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            elseif key == 'To' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            end
        end

        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1

                    DecompileFunction(v, false, indent + 1, "nil" .. tostring(UnknownProtos))
                )
        else
            String = String .. ("\n%slocal %s\n"):format(string.rep("  ", indent), DecompileFunction(v, false, indent + 1))
        end
    end
    return String .. "\n" .. consts .. Aconsts .. "\n" .. string.rep(" ", indent) .. "end"
end

function DecompileScript(Script)
    local Decompiled = "--[[ DECOMPILED WITH SIMPLEDECOMPILE ]]\n"
    if typeof(Script) == "Instance" and Script.ClassName == "ModuleScript" then
        local s, e =
            pcall(
            function()
                for i, v in require(Script) do
                    if type(v) == "table" then
                        if #v == 0 then
                            if type(i) == "number" then
                                Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\nlocal table_%d = {}; --[[ EMPTY TABLE ]]\n"):format(pKey1(i, v))
                            else
                                Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\nlocal %s = {}; --[[ EMPTY TABLE ]]\n"):format(i)
                            end
                        else
                            if type(i) == "number" then
                                Decompiled =
                                    Decompiled ..
                                    ("local table_%d = {\n%s};\n"):format(
                                        pKey1(i, v),
                                        processTableDescendants(v, 0, "t_" .. tostring(i))
                                    )
                            else
                                Decompiled =
                                    Decompiled ..
                                    ("local %s = {\n%s};\n"):format(
                                        i,
                                        processTableDescendants(v, 0, "t_" .. tostring(i))
                                    )
                            end
                        end
                elseif type(v) == 'function' then
                 if type(i) == 'number' then
                    Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\n%s"):format(DecompileFunction(v, false, 0, "f_"..tostring(i)))
                 else
                    Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\n%s"):format(DecompileFunction(v, false, 0))
                 end
                end
             end
            end
        )
        if not s then
            return "-- Error occured when trying to iterate over ModuleScript, Message: " .. e
        end
        return Decompiled
    end
    local s, e =
        pcall(
        function()
            local uks = 1
            for i, v in getsenv(Script) do
                if type(v) == "table" then
                    if #v == 0 then
                        if type(i) == "number" then
                            Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\nlocal table_%d = {}; --[[ EMPTY TABLE ]]\n"):format(pKey1(i, v))
                        else
                            Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\nlocal %s = {}; --[[ EMPTY TABLE ]]\n"):format(i)
                        end
                    else
                        if type(i) == "number" then
                            Decompiled =
                                Decompiled ..
                                ("local table_%d = {\n%s};"):format(
                                    pKey1(i, v),
                                    processTableDescendants(v, 0, "t_" .. tostring(i))
                                )
                        else
                            Decompiled =
                                Decompiled ..
                                ("local %s = {\n%s};\n"):format(i, processTableDescendants(v, 0, "t_" .. tostring(i)))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for i, v in gcsenv(Script) do -- garbage collection senv
                local name = debug.getinfo(v).name
                if name == nil and Settings.IncludeNils then
                    Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\n%s"):format(DecompileFunction(v, false, 0, "nil" .. tostring(uks)))
                    uks = uks + 1
                elseif name ~= nil then
                    Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\n%s"):format(DecompileFunction(v, false, 0))
                end
            end
        end
    )
    if not s then
        return " --An error occured while attempting to iterate over Script's enviroment!\nMessage: " .. e
    end
    return Decompiled
end

getgenv().decompile = DecompileScript
return DecompileScript
