local function setupSlider(parent, labelText, yPos, minVal, maxVal, startVal, onUpdate)
    local lbl = makeLabel(parent, labelText, yPos)
    local slider = Instance.new("Frame")
    slider.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14)
    slider.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPos + 18)
    slider.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SliderBg
    slider.BorderSizePixel = 0
    slider.ZIndex = 12
    slider.Parent = parent

    local sliderCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    sliderCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
    sliderCorner.Parent = slider

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    local startRelX = (startVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(startRelX, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.ZIndex = 13
    fill.Parent = slider
    local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
    fillCorner.Parent = fill

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(startRelX, -6, 0.5, -6)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Text
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.ZIndex = 14
    knob.Parent = slider
    local knobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    knobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    knobCorner.Parent = knob

    local isDragging = false
    local function update(inputPos)
        local relX = math.clamp((inputPos.X - slider.AbsolutePosition.X) / slider.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local value = minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * relX
        TweenService:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(0.06), { Size = UDim2.new(relX, 0, 1, 0) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.06), { Position = UDim2.new(relX, -6, 0.5, -6) }):Play()
        onUpdate(value)
    end
    slider.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            isDragging = true; update(input.Position)
        end
    end)
    slider.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then isDragging = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then update(input.Position) end
    end)
    return lbl
end

local flyEnabled = false
local flyConnection, flyBodyVelocity

local function startFly()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bv.Parent = hrp
    flyBodyVelocity = bv
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then hum.PlatformStand = true end
    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flyBodyVelocity then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local moveVec = Vector3.zero
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveVec += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveVec -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveVec -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveVec += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveVec += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then moveVec -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if moveVec.Magnitude > 0 then moveVec = moveVec.Unit * currentFlySpeed end
        flyBodyVelocity.Velocity = moveVec
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect(); flyConnection = nil end
    if flyBodyVelocity then flyBodyVelocity:Destroy(); flyBodyVelocity = nil end
    local char = player.Character
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
    end
end

-- FARM LOGIC (С СИСТЕМОЙ ПРОПУСКА И БЕЗ +5)
-- ============================================================
local farmOrbsActive = false
local farmXpActive = false

-- Черный список (запоминает объекты, к которым нельзя телепортироваться)
local skipList = {}

-- Очистка черного списка (если в нем больше 50 объектов или все орбы в нем)
local function clearSkipListIfNeeded()
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(skipList) do count = count + 1 end
    if count > 50 then
        skipList = {}
    end
end

-- Проверка, можно ли телепортироваться к объекту (он существует, он в Workspace, его не удалили)
local function isValidOrb(part)
    if not part or not part.Parent then return false end
    if skipList[part] then return false end
    return true
end

-- Поиск SandOrb / VoidOrb
local function findSandVoidOrb()
    clearSkipListIfNeeded()
    local orbs = {}
    
    local voidFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("VoidOrbs")
    if voidFolder then
        for _, obj in ipairs(voidFolder:GetChildren()) do
            local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if part and isValidOrb(part) then table.insert(orbs, part) end
        end
    end
    
    local sandFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("SandOrbs")
    if sandFolder then
        for _, obj in ipairs(sandFolder:GetChildren()) do
            local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if part and isValidOrb(part) then table.insert(orbs, part) end
        end
    end
    
    if #orbs > 0 then return orbs[1] end
    
    -- Если все орбы в черном списке, чистим его
    if #orbs == 0 and next(skipList) then
        skipList = {}
        return findSandVoidOrb()
    end
    
    return nil
end

-- Поиск Розового Orb (цвет 255, 110, 220)
local function findPinkOrb()
    clearSkipListIfNeeded()
    local orbs = {}
    local orbsFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Orbs")
    if orbsFolder then
        for _, obj in ipairs(orbsFolder:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name == "Orb" then
                local c = obj.Color
                if math.abs(c.R * 255 - 255) < 5 and math.abs(c.G * 255 - 110) < 5 and math.abs(c.B * 255 - 220) < 5 then
                    if isValidOrb(obj) then table.insert(orbs, obj) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    if #orbs > 0 then return orbs[1] end
    
    if #orbs == 0 and next(skipList) then
        skipList = {}
        return findPinkOrb()
    end
    
    return nil
end

-- Универсальный телепорт (Y = 0, ровно в центр)
local function teleportTo(part)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp and part then
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(part.Position) -- Смещение 0, ровно в центр
        return true
    end
    return false
end

            vHolder:ClearAllChildren()

            b.Parent = vHolder
            local t = NameTag:Clone()

            t.Tag.TextColor3 = Color3.new(v.TeamColor.r, v.TeamColor.g, v.TeamColor.b)

            v.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()

            v.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
                if prop == "TeamColor" then
                    UnloadCharacter(v)
                    task.wait()
                    LoadCharacter(v)
                end
            end)
            LoadCharacter(v)

        local UnloadPlayer = function(v)
            UnloadCharacter(v)

        local lastFolder = table.remove(spawnedDrawings)
        if lastFolder and lastFolder.Parent then
            lastFolder:Destroy()
            break
        end

local DelWorldBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
DelWorldBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 145, 0, 32)

DelWorldBtn.TextSize = 13

    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if obj.Name:match("^UserDrawing") then
            obj:Destroy()
        end
    end
    spawnedDrawings = {}
end)

-- Language Toggle Logic
LangBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
    currentLang = (currentLang == "RU") and "EN" or "RU"
    
    LangBtn.Text = texts[currentLang].LangBtn
    Title.Text = texts[currentLang].Title
    SizeBox.PlaceholderText = texts[currentLang].SizePlace
    DistBox.PlaceholderText = texts[currentLang].DistPlace
    CreateBtn.Text = texts[currentLang].Create
    ClearBtn.Text = texts[currentLang].Clear
    UndoBtn.Text = texts[currentLang].Undo
    DelLastBtn.Text = texts[currentLang].DelLast
    DelWorldBtn.Text = texts[currentLang].DelWorld
    
    if currentMode == "Draw" then
        ModeBtn.Text = texts[currentLang].ModeDraw
    else
        ModeBtn.Text = texts[currentLang].ModeErase
    end
    
    VolBtn.Text = isVolumetric and texts[currentLang].VolOn or texts[currentLang].VolOff
    
    for i, btn in ipairs(dirButtons) do
        btn.Text = texts[currentLang].Dirs[i]
    end
end)

-- Spawning Logic
CreateBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
    
    local blockSize = tonumber(SizeBox.Text) or 1
    local distance = tonumber(DistBox.Text) or 5
    
    local rootPos = hrp.Position
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(rootPos, Vector3.new(0, -20, 0), raycastParams)
    local floorY = raycastResult and raycastResult.Position.Y or (rootPos.Y - 3)
    
    local flatLook = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Unit.Z).Unit
    local flatRight = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.RightVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.RightVector.Unit.Z).Unit
    
    local spawnPos = rootPos
    local targetLook = flatLook
    
    -- 1: Forward, 2: Backward, 3: Left, 4: Right
    if selectedDirectionIndex == 1 then
        spawnPos = rootPos + flatLook * distance
        targetLook = -flatLook
    elseif selectedDirectionIndex == 2 then
        spawnPos = rootPos - flatLook * distance
        targetLook = flatLook
    elseif selectedDirectionIndex == 3 then
        spawnPos = rootPos - flatRight * distance
        targetLook = flatRight
    elseif selectedDirectionIndex == 4 then
        spawnPos = rootPos + flatRight * distance
        targetLook = -flatRight
    end
    
    spawnPos = Vector3.new(spawnPos.X, floorY, spawnPos.Z)
    local spawnCF = CFrame.new(spawnPos, spawnPos + targetLook)
    
    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "UserDrawing_" .. tostring(tick())
    folder.Parent = workspace
    table.insert(spawnedDrawings, folder)
    
    local depth = isVolumetric and 3 or 1
    
    for x = 1, gridSize do
        for y = 1, gridSize do
            local col = gridData[x][y]
            if col ~= Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50) then
                for z = 0, depth - 1 do
                    local part = Instance.new("Part")
                    part.Size = Vector3.new(blockSize, blockSize, blockSize)
                    part.Color = col
                    part.Anchored = true
                    part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                    
                    local xOffset = (x - gridSize / 2 - 0.5) * blockSize
                    local yOffset = ((gridSize - y) * blockSize) + (blockSize / 2)
                    local zOffset = z * blockSize
                    
                    part.CFrame = spawnCF * CFrame.new(xOffset, yOffset, zOffset)
                    part.Parent = folder
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- [[ Rscripts Risk Notice ]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

local selectedMode = "CFrame" 

-- Полная очистка старых версий хаба
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("XenoTeleportMenu") then
    CoreGui.XenoTeleportMenu:Destroy()
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "XenoTeleportMenu"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(ScreenGui) end

-- ГЛАВНЫЙ ФРЕЙМ (Размеры как на скриншоте)
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 160)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 0.4, -80)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24) 
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true 

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
UICorner.Parent = MainFrame

-- НАЗВАНИЕ ХАБА
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 8)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "MamutRakhal Hub"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.TextSize = 14
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Parent = MainFrame

-- ПОЛЕ ВВОДА КООРДИНАТ
local CoordInput = Instance.new("TextBox")
CoordInput.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 28)
CoordInput.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 38)
CoordInput.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 35)

local InputCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

-- КНОПКА РЕЖИМА: CFrame

local CFrameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

-- КНОПКА РЕЖИМА: WorldPivot
local BtnPivot = Instance.new("TextButton")

-- КНОПКА ТЕЛЕПОРТА

TpBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 114)

TpBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

TpBtn.Parent = MainFrame

local TpCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
TpCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
TpCorner.Parent = TpBtn

-- Анимация инпута
CoordInput.Focused:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(CoordInput, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 48)}):Play()
end)
CoordInput.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    TweenService:Create(CoordInput, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 35)}):Play()
end)

-- Переключение табов
local function updateButtons()
    if selectedMode == "CFrame" then
        TweenService:Create(BtnCFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 108, 224), TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(BtnPivot, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 175)}):Play()
    else
        TweenService:Create(BtnPivot, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(219, 114, 52), TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(BtnCFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 175)}):Play()
    end
end

BtnCFrame.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    selectedMode = "CFrame"
    updateButtons()
end)

BtnPivot.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    selectedMode = "WorldPivot"
    updateButtons()
end)

-- Выполнение телепортации
TpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local text = CoordInput.Text
    local x, y, z = text:match("([^,]+)%s*,%s*([^,]+)%s*,%s*([^,]+)")
    
    x = tonumber(x)
    y = tonumber(y)
    z = tonumber(z)
    
    if x and y and z then
        local character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        if selectedMode == "CFrame" then
            local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if rootPart then rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(x, y, z) end
        elseif selectedMode == "WorldPivot" then
            character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(x, y, z))
        end
    else
        CoordInput.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 35, 35)
        task.wait(0.3)
        CoordInput.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 35)
    end
end)

-- СИНХРОНИЗАЦИЯ КАМЕРЫ И КУРСОРA ИЗ ТВОЕГО ХАБА
local menuOpen = true
local function setMenuState(state)
    menuOpen = state
    MainFrame.Visible = state
    
    if state then
        -- Настройки ИЗ твоей функции setMenuVisible(true) при ОТКРЫТИИ
        Player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
        Player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 30 
        Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 5  
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true 
    else
        -- Настройки ИЗ твоей функции setMenuVisible(false) при ЗАКРЫТИИ
        Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
        Player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 0.5
        Player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false 
    end
end

-- Обработка бинда F1
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F1 then
        setMenuState(not menuOpen)
    end
end)

-- Отрисовка интерфейса на экран
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
setMenuState(true)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Keybinds = { MenuToggle = Enum.KeyCode.F1, TeleportBox = Enum.KeyCode.V }
local scriptUnloaded = false
local ActiveESP = {}
local Settings = { EspChams = false, EspZombies = false, EspDrones = false, EspVehicles = false, EspHealth = false, Optimization = false }
local connectionList = {}
local OptimizedParts = {}

local function addConnection(conn) table.insert(connectionList, conn) return conn end
local function isInMapBounds(pos) return pos.X >= 1103.25 and pos.X <= 3297.38 and pos.Z >= -1213.02 and pos.Z <= -26.99 end
local function sendMessage(text) pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "Mamut Rakhal Hub", Text = text, Duration = 5}) end) end

local function teleportToNearestDroneBox()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

    local closestModel = nil
    local minDist = math.huge

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj.Name == "DroneBox" then
            local partToCheck = obj:FindFirstChild("com_plasticcase_green_rifle") or obj.PrimaryPart
            if partToCheck then
                local dist = (char.HumanoidRootPart.Position - partToCheck.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < minDist then
                    minDist = dist
                    closestModel = obj
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not closestModel then return end
    local rootPart = closestModel.PrimaryPart or closestModel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if rootPart then
        char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
        sendMessage("Телепортировано к Дрон-Ящику")
    end
end

-- ✅ ИСПРАВЛЕННАЯ СИСТЕМА ОПТИМИЗАЦИИ И ПОЛНОГО СКРЫТИЯ ДЕРЕВЬЕВ С ЛИСТВОЙ
local function toggleOptimization(state)
    Settings.Optimization = state
    local terrain = Workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain") or Workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Terrain")
    if terrain then terrain.Decoration = not state end

    if state then
        -- 1. Полное тотальное скрытие папки AutoPlantedTrees (стволы, листва, ветки, меши)
        local autoTrees = Workspace:FindFirstChild("AutoPlantedTrees")
        if autoTrees then
            for _, obj in ipairs(autoTrees:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    OptimizedParts[obj] = { Transparency = obj.Transparency, CanCollide = obj.CanCollide, CanQuery = obj.CanQuery }
                    obj.Transparency = 1
                    obj.CanCollide = false
                    obj.CanQuery = false
                elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
                    OptimizedParts[obj] = { Transparency = obj.Transparency }
                    obj.Transparency = 1
                end
            end
        end

        -- 2. Скрытие травы и кустов на остальной карте
        for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj:IsDescendantOf(Workspace:FindFirstChild("AutoPlantedTrees") or game) then
                local name = string.lower(obj.Name)
                if string.find(name, "grass") or string.find(name, "plant") or string.find(name, "weed") or string.find(name, "foliage") or string.find(name, "bush") or string.find(name, "tree") then
                    OptimizedParts[obj] = { Transparency = obj.Transparency, CanCollide = obj.CanCollide, CanQuery = obj.CanQuery }
                    obj.Transparency = 1
                    obj.CanCollide = false
                    obj.CanQuery = false
                end
            end
            if not obj:IsDescendantOf(Workspace:FindFirstChild("AutoPlantedTrees") or game) then
                if obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then 
                    obj.Transparency = 1
                elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then 
                    obj.Enabled = false 
                end
            end
        end
    else
        -- Полный возврат текстур и физики при выключении тумблера
        for part, props in pairs(OptimizedParts) do
            if part and part.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    part.Transparency = props.Transparency
                    if props.CanCollide ~= nil then
                        part.CanCollide = props.CanCollide
                        part.CanQuery = props.CanQuery
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(OptimizedParts)
    end
end

-- ✅ ЛОКАЛЬНЫЕ ОРГАНЫ УПРАВЛЕНИЯ ИНТЕРФЕЙСОМ

Instance.new("UICorner", minimizeBtnObj).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local function setMenuVisible(visible)
    if scriptUnloaded then return end
    mainFrame.Visible = visible
    if visible then
        player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
        player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 30 
        player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 5

minimizeBtnObj.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setMenuVisible(false) end)

local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
dragHeader.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true; dragStart = input.Position; startPos = mainFrame.Position

    end

local visualPage, miscPage, settingsPage = createPage("Visual"), createPage("Misc"), createPage("Settings")
local function createScrollingContent(parent)
local sc = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local gameConfig = require(shared.Config)
local registry = require(shared.Abilities.Registry)
local characterUtil = require(shared.Util.CharacterUtil)
local dashController = require(shared.Client.DashController)
local behaviors = shared.Abilities.Behaviors
local environment = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G

for _, name in ipairs({
    "CombatControls",
    "CombatTapDash",
    "CombatHoldSpam",
    "M1DashInput",
    "M1DashProbe",
    "CombatDashProbe",
}) do
    local previous = environment[name]
    if previous and type(previous.unload) == "function" then
        pcall(previous.unload)
    end
end

local settings = {
    m1Interval = 0.09,
    m1TapDuration = 0.70,
    abilityInterval = 0.55,
    abilityTapDuration = 0.05,
    abilityCooldown = 0.05,
    dashCooldown = 0.02,
}

local active = true
local held = { m1 = false, e = false, r = false }
local deadline = { m1 = 0, e = 0, r = 0 }
local running = { m1 = false, e = false, r = false }
local originalValues = {}
local behaviorCache = {}
local connections = {}

local function setCooldown(container, key, value)
    if type(container) ~= "table" or type(container[key]) ~= "number" then
        return
    end

    local previous = originalValues[container]
    if not previous then
        previous = {}
        originalValues[container] = previous
    end
    if previous[key] == nil then
        previous[key] = container[key]
    end

    container[key] = math.min(container[key], value)
end

local function applyCooldowns()
    setCooldown(gameConfig.Dash, "Cooldown", settings.dashCooldown)

    local moveset = registry.GetMoveset(player:GetAttribute("Moveset"))
    if not moveset then
        return
    end

    setCooldown(moveset, "DashRefill", settings.dashCooldown)
    for _, ability in ipairs(moveset.Abilities) do
        setCooldown(ability.Config, "Cooldown", settings.abilityCooldown)
        setCooldown(ability.Config, "MinCooldown", settings.abilityCooldown)
    end
end

local function restoreCooldowns()
    for container, values in pairs(originalValues) do
        for key, value in pairs(values) do
            container[key] = value
        end
    end
    table.clear(originalValues)
end

local function canAct()
    if player:GetAttribute("InGame") ~= true then
        return false
    end

    local character, humanoid, root = characterUtil.GetParts(player)
    return character ~= nil and humanoid ~= nil and root ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function getAbility(mode)
    local moveset = registry.GetMoveset(player:GetAttribute("Moveset"))
    if not moveset then
        return nil
    end

    if mode == "m1" then
        return moveset.Abilities[1]
    end

    return registry.AbilityForSlot(moveset, mode == "e" and 1 or 2)
end

local function activate(mode)
    if not canAct() then
        return
    end

    local ability = getAbility(mode)
    if not ability then
        return
    end

    local kind = ability.Config.Kind
    if mode == "m1" and kind ~= "Attack" then
        return
    end

    local behavior = behaviorCache[kind]
    if not behavior then
        local module = behaviors:FindFirstChild(kind)
        if not module then
            return
        end

        local success, loaded = pcall(require, module)
        if not success then
            return
        end

        behavior = loaded
        behaviorCache[kind] = behavior
    end

    pcall(function()
        behavior.new(ability):Activate()
    end)
end

local function repeatAction(mode)
    if running[mode] then
        return
    end

    running[mode] = true
    local interval = mode == "m1" and settings.m1Interval or settings.abilityInterval
    while active and (held[mode] or os.clock() < deadline[mode]) do
        activate(mode)
        task.wait(interval)
    end
    running[mode] = false
end

local function beginAction(mode)
    held[mode] = true
    local duration = mode == "m1" and settings.m1TapDuration or settings.abilityTapDuration
    deadline[mode] = math.max(deadline[mode], os.clock() + duration)
    if not running[mode] then
        task.spawn(repeatAction, mode)
    end
end

local function endAction(mode)
    held[mode] = false
end

local function unload()
    if not active then
        return
    end

    active = false
    for mode in pairs(held) do
        held[mode] = false
        deadline[mode] = 0
    end
    ContextActionService:UnbindAction("CombatControlsDash")
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    restoreCooldowns()
    environment.CombatControls = nil
end

environment.CombatControls = { unload = unload }

ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority("CombatControlsDash", function(_, state)
    if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
        return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
    end
    if active and state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
        pcall(dashController.TryDash)
    end
    return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink

connections[#connections + 1] = player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Moveset"):Connect(applyCooldowns)
connections[#connections + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F11 then

    end

        return
    end

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        beginAction("m1")
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
        beginAction("e")
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then
        beginAction("r")
    end
end)

connections[#connections + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        endAction("m1")
